notes: L in all effect text = current level of this affinity.
Opposing affinities are mutually exclusive unless a Bridge Affinity is taken.
Primal unlock rule: character must have MND + SPT > total number of Arcane Elemental Affinities known.
Emotional level 2 always follows: Max pool +L², pool regen +L for governing stat pool.
Affinity Styles are separate skills that require an Affinity as a prerequisite — see affinity_styles section.
Bridge Affinities are Tier 2 Emotional Affinities that resolve conflicts between opposing pairs.
Arcane affinities represent schools of magical philosophy rather than primal forces.

universal.description: Metaphysical alignments tied to moral forces. Channeled by clerics, monks, mystics, zealots. Opposing alignments are mutually exclusive unless a Bridge Affinity is learned.

chastity.name: Chastity
chastity.theme: Virtue of Survival: clarity, restraint, quality.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Clarity.

3.effect: Gain L MP when hit.

4.effect: Spend L Clarity to reduce next MP cost by L.

5.effect: If you have no Clarity stacks, gain 1 at the start of your turn.

lust.name: Lust
lust.theme: Vice of Survival: passion, desire, pursuit.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Invigorate.

3.effect: Gain L SP on hit.

4.effect: Dealing damage gains 1 Invigorate.

5.effect: At Max Invigorate, next attack costs 0 SP.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Fortify.

3.effect: Damage reduced converts to MP restored.

4.effect: +L Fortify stack limit.

5.effect: While Fortify is active, reduce magic damage taken by L.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Regenerate.

3.effect: Overhealing converts to MP or SP.

4.effect: +L to healing received while Regenerating.

5.effect: Overflow Regen stores up to L bonus stacks.

1.effect: Target ally gains L stacks of Barrier.

3.effect: Reducing damage restores MP.

4.effect: Ally hit within 10 ft — transfer L MP to them.

5.effect: Lose MP instead of HP when hit.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Harden.

3.effect: Reducing damage restores SP.

4.effect: SP beyond Max converts to Temp Shield.

5.effect: Gain L SP when Harden reduces damage.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Hasten.

3.effect: Within 5 ft of an ally, take half their incoming damage.

4.effect: Damage taken on behalf of another is reduced by L.

5.effect: Allies within 5 ft gain +L to healing received.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Empower.

3.effect: Heal for half of damage dealt.

4.effect: +L damage vs enemies that damaged you last turn.

5.effect: At Max Empower, gain +1 AP per round.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Focus or Alert (your choice).

3.effect: On hit, spend Focus stacks to gain L SP.

4.effect: No AP spent during upkeep grants +1 AP next turn.

5.effect: Hitting 3 or more targets in a round restores L SP.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Bolstered.

3.effect: Gain L MP when hit.

4.effect: First action each turn costs -L SP.

5.effect: If no AP is used during a turn, regain +1 AP at round end.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Ambition.

3.effect: MP beyond Max converts to HP.

4.effect: When an enemy has an active buff, gain L MP.

5.effect: On hit, steal 1 beneficial effect from the target.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Flow.

3.effect: If SP cost would go below 0, restore the difference as SP.

4.effect: Evading an effect gains 1 Flow stack.

5.effect: While Flow is active, gain a free reroll on one defense per round.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Concentration.

3.effect: If MP cost would go below 0, restore the difference as MP.

4.effect: At Max Concentration, gain +L to healing and damage.

5.effect: On attack hit, gain 1 Concentration stack.

1.effect: Target ally gains L stacks of Inspiration.

3.effect: SP beyond Max converts to HP.

4.effect: Inspired allies gain +L Temp HP.

5.effect: Inspiration stacks can be shared — 1 per ally within 10 ft.

detachment.name: Detachment
detachment.theme: The space between purity and desire — neither bound nor empty.

1.effect: Hold Chastity and Lust without conflict. Clarity and Invigorate stacks each contribute +L to the same checks when both are active.

3.effect: Once per long rest, shed all emotional status effects (positive and negative) and gain L² MP restoration — a clean slate.

4.effect: You cannot be compelled or seduced. Charm, Fear, and Enchantment effects require L additional successes to affect you.

5.effect: Once per session, step outside a conflict entirely for L rounds — you are untouchable and neutral, observing without being observed.

change.name: Change
change.theme: The equilibrium that knows when to indulge and when to restrain.

1.effect: Hold Temperance and Gluttony without conflict. Fortify and Regenerate stacks each contribute +L to the same checks when both are active.

3.effect: After receiving any damage type for the first time in an encounter, gain L resistance to that type for the remainder of the encounter.

4.effect: Once per long rest, reset all status stack counts to their ideal value (GM adjudicates) — the self finds balance between excess and control.

5.effect: Once per session, adapt completely: redistribute your stat points optimally for the current challenge for L rounds, then return to normal.

love.name: Love
love.theme: The force that drives both giving everything and wanting everything.

1.effect: Hold Charity and Greed without conflict. Barrier and Harden stacks each contribute +L to the same checks when both are active.

3.effect: Grant an ally Barrier (L² HP absorbed) while simultaneously gaining L stacks of Harden yourself — protecting others steels you.

4.effect: Willingly taking damage or spending resources for another grants you L² MP restoration and L stacks of Fortify.

5.effect: Once per session, sacrifice any amount of your HP or SP to instantly restore allies proportionally — what you give returns doubled at encounter end.

loss.name: Loss
loss.theme: Grief that teaches — the place where endurance and rage meet and become something wiser.

1.effect: Hold Patience and Wrath without conflict. Hasten and Empower stacks each contribute +L to the same checks when both are active.

3.effect: When an ally falls in combat, gain L² HP restoration and +L to all rolls for one round as loss becomes purpose.

4.effect: Once per long rest, convert all damage taken this encounter into Empower stacks (1 stack per 5 HP lost). The pain was not wasted.

5.effect: Once per session, declare that a past loss has meaning — re-enter the session with full HP, all wounds treated as lessons rather than wounds.

discovery.name: Discovery
discovery.theme: The insight that arises from neither grinding effort nor complete stillness — but both.

1.effect: Hold Diligence and Sloth without conflict. Focus and Bolstered stacks each contribute +L to the same checks when both are active.

3.effect: Once per long rest, after spending a round doing nothing (only defending), gain L² SP and +L to all rolls for the following round.

4.effect: Once per encounter, declare a Moment of Insight — any ability used this round costs 0 AP and gains +L effect from the burst of clarity.

5.effect: Once per session, enter a trance for L rounds. You act last but all actions gain +L² and you may retroactively choose your targets after seeing results.

gratitude.name: Gratitude
gratitude.theme: The recognition that abundance and lack are two faces of the same gift.

1.effect: Hold Generosity and Envy without conflict. Inspiration and Ambition stacks each contribute +L to the same checks when both are active.

3.effect: Each time an ally uses an ability on your behalf, gain L MP restoration and apply L stacks of Inspiration back to them in gratitude.

4.effect: Clear all negative statuses from yourself; convert their stack counts to matching positive statuses. See what was always there.

5.effect: Once per session, when you receive any resource from an ally, the giver receives the same amount back — gratitude multiplies.

dignity.name: Dignity
dignity.theme: The self that neither puffs up nor diminishes — true worth needs no defense.

1.effect: Hold Humility and Pride without conflict. Flow and Concentration stacks each contribute +L to the same checks when both are active.

3.effect: You are immune to Suppressed, Humiliated, and Broken. Allies within L×10 ft resist those same effects at +L.

4.effect: Declare your genuine worth. All allies in L×15 ft gain +L to all checks for L rounds. All enemies make a Resolve check or become Awed for L rounds.

5.effect: Your stats cannot be reduced by external effects. Mind-altering effects automatically fail against you. Once per session, negate any effect that would change your fundamental nature.

chastity_initiate.name: Chastity Initiate
chastity_initiate.theme: Disciplined mind — the first deepening of clarity into true mental fortitude.

1.effect: Clarity stacks grant an additional +L to MND-based checks. Clarity duration increases by L rounds.

3.effect: Purge one negative mental status from yourself and apply L stacks of Clarity.

4.effect: While you have 10+ Clarity stacks, your MND is treated as L higher for all checks and abilities.

5.effect: While Clarity is active, you are immune to compulsion, fear, and confusion. All MP costs are reduced by L (minimum 1).

lust_initiate.name: Lust Initiate
lust_initiate.theme: Awakened desire — vital energy sharpened into a tool.

1.effect: Invigorate grants an additional +L to SPT-based checks. You gain L bonus SP on a confirmed Hit.

3.effect: Apply L stacks of Invigorate to yourself and one willing target. The target also gains L bonus SP.

4.effect: When you hit an enemy, siphon L SP from them (they lose it; you gain it).

5.effect: Once per session, enter a state of pure desire for L rounds. All SPT checks succeed on 1+. Recover L² SP on any kill.

temperance_initiate.name: Temperance Initiate
temperance_initiate.theme: Measured control — discipline becomes an active defense.

1.effect: Fortify grants +L to all resistance checks. You may spend MP to reduce incoming damage by L per MP spent (decided after rolling).

3.effect: When you would receive a negative status, spend L MP to reduce its duration by L rounds.

4.effect: Distribute up to L² MP among allies as HP healing. Each recipient also gains L stacks of Fortify.

5.effect: Your resource pools cannot be reduced below L² by external effects. With 10+ Fortify stacks, you are immune to mental domination.

1.effect: Regenerate heals +L additional SP per round. You gain the Regenerate status automatically after consuming any item or resource.

3.effect: Consume a downed enemy or material within reach. Gain L² SP and L stacks of Regenerate.

4.effect: Each time you fully consume a resource or finish a Devour, gain L bonus SP and +L to your next attack.

5.effect: Enter a feeding frenzy for L rounds. Every hit restores L SP; every kill restores L². Area attacks heal L SP per target hit.

charity_initiate.name: Charity Initiate
charity_initiate.theme: Giving protection — selfless power fuels those around you.

1.effect: Barrier absorbs +L² additional damage. You may transfer L MP to an ally as a free action once per round.

3.effect: Grant up to L allies Barrier (L² HP absorption) for L rounds.

4.effect: When an ally would drop to 0 HP, spend L MP to negate the killing blow — the ally remains at 1 HP.

5.effect: All resource transfers from you are doubled. Allies within L×10 ft gain +L to all defenses. Sacrificed resources are half-returned at the start of your next turn.

1.effect: Harden grants +L to physical resistance. Each time you gain any resource (item, SP, MP, HP), gain L bonus SP.

3.effect: Attack that steals L MP or SP (your choice) from the target. Apply L stacks of Harden to yourself.

4.effect: For every 10 SP above your base maximum, gain +1 to all resistance checks (max +L).

5.effect: You cannot lose more than L² resources per round from enemy effects. Once per session, declare Bankruptcy Reversal — all resources taken from you this session return plus L%.

patience_initiate.name: Patience Initiate
patience_initiate.theme: Endurance rewarded — delayed power pays dividends.

1.effect: Hasten grants +L to initiative and dodge checks. Each round you refrain from attacking, gain L Endurance stacks (+1 to next attack each).

3.effect: For each consecutive round spent preparing rather than attacking, your next attack deals +L² bonus damage and applies L status stacks of your choice.

4.effect: Your HP cannot drop below L from any single hit. Automatically stabilize at L HP instead of dying from a single blow.

5.effect: Patience stacks never expire. At 10+ stacks, incoming damage is halved and your next attack deals stacks×2L bonus damage.

wrath_initiate.name: Wrath Initiate
wrath_initiate.theme: Explosive force — received pain becomes outgoing destruction.

1.effect: Empower grants +L to all damage rolls. You gain L Empower stacks whenever you take a hit.

3.effect: Charge up to L×10 ft, dealing L² damage to all enemies in your path and applying L Empower stacks to yourself.

4.effect: When you drop below 30% HP, all damage dealt doubles and HPR increases by +L². This ends when you return above 50% HP.

5.effect: Channel pure fury for L rounds — immune to pain and stun. All attacks gain +L² damage. Every kill restores L² HP.

diligence_initiate.name: Diligence Initiate
diligence_initiate.theme: Focused effort — skill compounds into mastery.

1.effect: Focus/Alert grants +L to all skill checks. While Alert, attempt the same skill check twice and take the better result.

3.effect: Any task you spend at least 2 consecutive turns focused on receives +L² to the final check.

4.effect: You may take one additional Craft, Study, or Prepare action per round without spending extra AP.

5.effect: Alert grants an additional +L to all checks. Once per encounter, declare a Practiced Technique — the ability costs 0 and automatically succeeds.

sloth_initiate.name: Sloth Initiate
sloth_initiate.theme: Effortless power — economy of action becomes its own strength.

1.effect: Bolstered grants +L to passive defenses. Actions that cost 0 AP deal +L bonus effect.

3.effect: Each round you spend no AP, recover L² MP and gain L stacks of Bolstered.

4.effect: Once per round, an ability that costs 2+ AP costs L fewer AP (minimum 0).

5.effect: All your abilities cost L less AP (minimum 0). When you take 0 actions in a round, gain L passive charges; spend charges to add +L² to any roll.

generosity_initiate.name: Generosity Initiate
generosity_initiate.theme: Abundant giving — your overflow becomes everyone's gain.

1.effect: Inspiration stacks you grant to allies give +L instead of the base bonus. You gain L SP when you grant Inspiration to an ally.

3.effect: Grant L stacks of Inspiration to all allies within L×10 ft.

4.effect: Allies with Inspiration from you gain +L to all rolls (not just their next check). They may pass their stacks to another ally as a free action.

5.effect: You produce twice as many Inspiration stacks. Allies under your Inspiration cannot have their SP reduced below L².

envy_initiate.name: Envy Initiate
envy_initiate.theme: Sharpened hunger — desire for what others have becomes tactical advantage.

1.effect: Ambition stacks double their bonus when targeting someone with higher stats. You sense the stat distribution of any being within L×20 ft.

3.effect: Target one enemy. For L rounds, identify their highest stat and copy it as a +L bonus to your checks against them.

4.effect: For each stat in which an enemy exceeds yours, gain +L to attacks against that specific enemy.

5.effect: Ambition stacks never expire. With 10+ stacks, copy any ability used by an enemy or ally within L×20 ft and use it once this encounter.

humility_initiate.name: Humility Initiate
humility_initiate.theme: Selfless power — by giving yourself away, you become more.

1.effect: Flow grants +L to support and reaction checks. You gain Flow stacks when you aid others.

3.effect: Transfer your current Flow stacks to an ally. They treat their next check as if they had rolled maximum.

4.effect: The fewer abilities you've used this encounter, the stronger your remaining ones (+L per unused ability slot, max +L²).

5.effect: You cannot be targeted by forced-movement, mind-control, or ego effects. All allies count you as having the highest relevant stat for assistance bonuses.

pride_initiate.name: Pride Initiate
pride_initiate.theme: Commanding presence — unshakeable self-belief radiates outward.

1.effect: Concentration grants +L to all-or-nothing checks. Enemies who witness your victories gain L stacks of Suppressed.

3.effect: Assert dominance — all enemies within L×15 ft make a Willpower check or become Suppressed for L rounds.

4.effect: With 5+ Concentration stacks, your abilities cannot be interrupted or countered. Concentration is spent instead of a counter-roll.

5.effect: You cannot critically fail. With 10+ Concentration stacks, you are immune to charm, submission, and humiliation effects. Once per session, when reduced to 0 HP, remain at 1 HP with L² Concentration stacks.

chastity_adept.name: Chastity Adept
chastity_adept.theme: Purified form — clarity as a field that extends outward.

1.effect: Clarity stacks remove one negative status on application. MND is treated as +L higher for Clarity-driven effects.

3.effect: Negative statuses expire L rounds faster on you. With 15+ Clarity stacks, you are immune to all mental status effects.

4.effect: Emit pure clarity in a L×15 ft radius. All allies gain 10 Clarity stacks; all negative mental statuses in the area are cleansed.

5.effect: Clarity never expires on you — you generate L stacks per round automatically. Allies within your aura share half your Clarity stacks.

lust_adept.name: Lust Adept
lust_adept.theme: Mastered desire — vital energy becomes magnetic and transferable.

1.effect: Invigorate stacks grant +L to all SPT-based attacks. Your presence causes enemies to lose L SP per round (vitality drawn toward you).

3.effect: Channel overwhelming desire — all enemies within L×15 ft must resist (MND vs your SPT) or lose L AP on their next turn.

4.effect: Each hit restores L SP from the target. This cannot kill but leaves them weakened.

5.effect: Your SP cannot drop below L². When at maximum SP, all attacks deal +L² bonus damage and automatically apply Invigorate to allies who witness them.

temperance_adept.name: Temperance Adept
temperance_adept.theme: Perfect balance — discipline becomes a gift you share.

1.effect: Fortify stacks reduce all damage types by L per 2 stacks. You may distribute Fortify stacks to allies within L×15 ft as a reaction.

3.effect: You cannot exceed 100 stacks of any status. Instead, excess stacks convert to the opposite beneficial status at L:1 ratio.

4.effect: Redistribute all status stacks equally among all allies within L×15 ft. This optimization provides +L to all actions for L rounds.

5.effect: Your stats are always treated as being at their optimal value for any given check. Extreme effects (maximum damage, critical failure) are moderated by L.

1.effect: Regenerate now also restores L HP per round. Your resource pools expand — excess restoration overflows to adjacent allies.

3.effect: You can consume any material substance as a standard action, converting it to L² SP restoration. Environmental materials count.

4.effect: Excess SP and HP restoration converts to Satiated stacks (+L to all checks per 10 stacks, max L×10) rather than being lost.

5.effect: Regenerate grants L SP and L HP per round. Allies you share meals with outside combat recover L² of all resources.

charity_adept.name: Charity Adept
charity_adept.theme: Sacred giving — protection becomes sacrifice, and sacrifice becomes power.

1.effect: Barrier stacks you apply absorb +L² damage each. You may grant Barrier as a reaction to an incoming hit targeting an ally.

3.effect: Grant one ally an impenetrable barrier absorbing L²×2 damage and lasting L rounds.

4.effect: You may redirect any damage dealt to an ally within L×20 ft to yourself. Damage redirected this way is halved.

5.effect: All protection you grant is doubled. You cannot die while an ally is below half HP — you stabilize at 1 HP. Once per session: sacrifice HP to restore allies proportionally.

greed_adept.name: Greed Adept
greed_adept.theme: Masterful acquisition — the hoard becomes a fortress.

1.effect: Harden stacks reduce all damage by L per 2 stacks. You sense resources (items, SP, MP) within L×20 ft.

3.effect: Drain L² SP or MP from target. For every L resources drained this encounter, gain +L stacks of Harden until end of session.

4.effect: Enemies within L×15 ft lose L SP per round passively drawn to you. You may suppress this effect.

5.effect: Your Harden cannot be stripped. For every 50 SP above maximum you hold, gain L damage reduction. Resources stolen by enemies are automatically returned within L rounds.

patience_adept.name: Patience Adept
patience_adept.theme: Absolute endurance — the mountain does not hurry.

1.effect: Hasten grants +L to all movement and reaction checks. You gain L Endurance per round automatically in combat.

3.effect: You may hold your action indefinitely. When you finally strike, deal L bonus damage per round held (max L×5).

4.effect: HP reduction effects are halved. For every round you do not attack aggressively, gain +L to MND and SPT checks.

5.effect: Effects that force immediate action automatically fail against you. When you finally strike, enemies make a Fortitude check vs your HP max or are Stunned for L rounds.

wrath_adept.name: Wrath Adept
wrath_adept.theme: Righteous fury — unstoppable force, escalating momentum.

1.effect: Empower grants +L to all attack types. You gain L² HP when you reduce an enemy to 0 HP.

3.effect: If an attack reduces an enemy below 30% HP without killing them, you may immediately make a free follow-up attack.

4.effect: Enter a sustained frenzy for L rounds — all attacks hit, damage increases by L², and status effects cannot stop you.

5.effect: Your presence deals L psychic damage to enemies each round. Empower stacks cannot be removed. At max HP, all your attacks are critical hits.

diligence_adept.name: Diligence Adept
diligence_adept.theme: Refined expertise — repetition elevates craft into art.

1.effect: Alert grants +L² to skill checks. You may attempt L+1 actions per AP period.

3.effect: Any ability used 3+ times in an encounter has its cost reduced by L and its effect increased by +L.

4.effect: You cannot be Exhausted or Dazed. Your SP never drops below L² while in combat.

5.effect: Non-combat actions take half the normal time. Combat abilities used 5+ times in an encounter automatically crit.

sloth_adept.name: Sloth Adept
sloth_adept.theme: Mastered ease — stillness becomes the most potent force in the room.

1.effect: Bolstered stacks reduce damage from any source by L. Being inactive is never treated as a weakness.

3.effect: Enemies who attack you suffer L SP drain per hit — the effort of striking you costs them.

4.effect: Your highest-tier ability costs 0 AP once per round. Abilities used while stationary deal +L² bonus effect.

5.effect: You recover L² MP per round without taking actions. Your passive defenses equal your active defenses. Once per session, your stillness resolves a conflict without combat.

generosity_adept.name: Generosity Adept
generosity_adept.theme: Overflow abundance — your giving creates a tide that lifts all.

1.effect: Inspiration stacks persist L rounds longer. When you inspire an ally, you both recover L SP.

3.effect: Release all current Inspiration stacks in a burst — all allies within L×20 ft receive L stacks each plus L² SP.

4.effect: When any ally recovers SP, you recover half that amount as well. Any resource above your maximum is automatically distributed to the lowest ally.

5.effect: You generate L Inspiration stacks per round for free distribution. SP regeneration benefits all allies within L×15 ft equally. You cannot drop below L SP while any ally has positive SP.

envy_adept.name: Envy Adept
envy_adept.theme: Consuming hunger — the wanting becomes the weapon.

1.effect: Ambition stacks double their bonus against targets with higher stats. You can perceive the exact stat distribution of any being within L×30 ft.

3.effect: Target one enemy. For L rounds, copy their highest passive bonus and apply it to yourself. They are aware this is happening.

4.effect: Each time an enemy uses an ability that exceeds your current power, you gain a copy of its passive effect for the remainder of the encounter.

5.effect: With 20+ Ambition stacks, your stats equal the highest stat values of any enemy in the encounter. These stats persist until end of session.

humility_adept.name: Humility Adept
humility_adept.theme: Profound selflessness — invisible strength that cannot be measured or broken.

1.effect: Flow stacks make your presence imperceptible as a threat — enemies do not target you unless you are the only option or you attack.

3.effect: Your power is immeasurable by external observation. Ability checks made against you reveal no information about your capabilities.

4.effect: All assistance bonuses you provide are doubled. You may take any ally's turn using your stats (with their permission).

5.effect: All incoming effects targeting your stats or resources are halved. Allies you support with Flow treat their critical failures as successes.

pride_adept.name: Pride Adept
pride_adept.theme: Unassailable ego — divine confidence that commands the battlefield.

1.effect: Concentration stacks cannot be removed by enemy effects. Enemies suffer -L to checks made against you.

3.effect: Your base stats cannot be reduced by any external effect. You have complete awareness of all enemy stat totals.

4.effect: Declare your supremacy — all enemies within L×20 ft make a Resolve check or become Intimidated for L rounds, granting you +L to all rolls against them.

5.effect: You always know if an effect will fail before attempting it. Your stats are treated as L higher for all defensive purposes. Once per session, succeed on any single check automatically.

acceptance.name: Acceptance
acceptance.theme: Loss fully received — grief that becomes peace, pain that becomes clarity.

1.effect: Loss is recognized as part of the cycle. Losing HP, SP, or MP triggers L recovery at the start of your next turn.

3.effect: Negative statuses last L rounds shorter on you. A damaging effect that would reduce you by 20+ HP is accepted and L% redirected as healing.

4.effect: Enter complete acceptance for L rounds — immune to movement and disruption, incoming damage is halved, and all HP lost heals allies within L×15 ft.

5.effect: You cannot die from sudden damage. Any blow that would kill you reduces you to L HP instead. Once per session, make any die result the value you choose.

metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
metamorphosis.theme: Change fully embraced — the self that transforms is no self at all.

1.effect: After receiving any damage type for the first time in an encounter, gain L resistance to that type for the remainder of the encounter.

3.effect: Undergo profound change — reset all negative statuses and redistribute stat points optimally for current challenges (GM adjudicates) for L rounds.

4.effect: You do not have a fixed true form. Gain L resistance to all damage types as your form continuously adapts.

5.effect: Ability costs are reduced by L as you perfectly fit your approach to each moment. You cannot be permanently altered by any external effect — change is yours alone.

liberation.name: Liberation
liberation.theme: Detachment perfected — freedom from both attachment and its absence.

1.effect: Freed from both attachment and emptiness, you act without hesitation. Reaction speed is +L. You cannot be held, bound, or paralyzed.

3.effect: All movement restrictions on you are removed at the start of each turn. You may pass through difficult terrain and non-magical barriers freely.

4.effect: Transcend physical and emotional constraints for L rounds — immune to all status effects. Deal L² untyped damage to anything that attempts to contain or bind you.

5.effect: You exist beyond categorization. Once per encounter, choose to exist outside the conflict entirely for L rounds — untouchable and non-threatening to all.

devotion.name: Devotion
devotion.theme: Love matured — the force that gives everything for a chosen purpose.

1.effect: Gain L bonus effect on any action taken on behalf of a declared beloved person or cause.

3.effect: Willingly taking damage or loss on behalf of another grants you L² restoration and L rounds of Empower.

4.effect: Designate a Devotion target (lasts until end of session). You and that target share healing — any healing to one heals the other for L%. You may redirect damage to yourself at will.

5.effect: All abilities benefiting your Devotion target have doubled effect. If your target is reduced to 0 HP, you have L rounds of Berserker immunity to reach them and restore them.

wisdom.name: Wisdom
wisdom.theme: Discovery matured — effort and understanding become one weapon.

1.effect: For each unique enemy type defeated this session, gain +L to all rolls.

3.effect: On the second round of any encounter, you intuit enemy weaknesses. Attacks against identified weaknesses deal +L² bonus damage.

4.effect: Combine effort and understanding — your next attack deals L²×(rounds analyzed) damage, where analyzed means rounds spent observing rather than attacking.

5.effect: Your highest attack stat and your highest mental stat are treated as equal — use whichever is higher. Critical hits grant L rounds of comprehensive situational awareness.

abundance.name: Abundance
abundance.theme: Gratitude perfected — the gap between giving and wanting dissolves.

1.effect: The gap between giving and wanting dissolves. Gain L² SP at the start of each encounter.

3.effect: When your SP exceeds maximum, the overflow becomes freely distributable MP or HP rather than being lost.

4.effect: Create a field of abundance in L×20 ft for L rounds. All allies recover L² SP per round. All enemies suffer L SP drain per round.

5.effect: You cannot be made to experience scarcity. When you give resources away, both you and the recipient receive L% extra. Ambition in others transforms to Inspiration in your presence.

sovereignty.name: Sovereignty
sovereignty.theme: Dignity matured — self-determination that commands through truth, not force.

1.effect: No external effect can define your actions or worth. Gain +L to all Resolve checks. Sovereignty cannot be suppressed or compelled.

3.effect: You establish L×15 ft as your sovereign domain. Within it, your defenses are doubled and allies gain +L to all checks.

4.effect: Assert sovereignty — all enemies within L×20 ft must submit (fail a Resolve check vs your SPT+MND) or cannot take aggressive actions for L rounds.

5.effect: Your mere existence deals L psychic damage per round to those who attempt to subjugate you. Once per session, your will overrides any effect that would alter your fundamental being.

compassion.name: Compassion
compassion.theme: To suffer with another — empathy that absorbs pain and transforms it into protection.

1.effect: When an ally takes damage, you gain L Endurance stacks but also take L unmitigated empathic damage (emotional resonance).

3.effect: When an ally within L×20 ft takes damage, absorb L of it yourself and grant them L stacks of Hasten.

4.effect: Damage absorbed on behalf of others is reduced to 50%. The absorbed suffering heals allies within L×10 ft for the same amount.

5.effect: You cannot be Feared or Broken while allies are present. Each HP sacrificed for others grants L permanent Endurance until end of session. Allies beside you regenerate +L HP per round.

valor.name: Valor
valor.theme: Disciplined courage — effort and fury fused into heroic resolve.

1.effect: Effort and anger are unified. All attacks gain +L and treat all enemies as Weakened.

3.effect: Heroic Charge — move up to L×15 ft, striking all enemies in path for L² damage. Allies who witness this gain L stacks of Empower.

4.effect: When fighting outnumbered or against a superior enemy, gain +L to all rolls per enemy that outclasses you.

5.effect: Enemies with lower HP maximum suffer -L to attacks against you (your endurance intimidates them). Your critical hits grant allies L² HP restoration.

obsession.name: Obsession
obsession.theme: All-consuming fixation — desire sharpened to a single devastating point.

1.effect: Designate one Obsession target. Against them, all checks are made at +L². Against all others, -L.

3.effect: Your Obsession target cannot Hide, Flee, or Vanish from your awareness regardless of any effect.

4.effect: While your Obsession target lives, you cannot be killed — stabilize at 1 HP. When they are resolved, lose L² of all resources in grief or release.

5.effect: Against your Obsession target, your level is treated as 5 higher and all abilities automatically succeed. If they become an ally, transfer the bond — both gain +L² against any shared enemy.

tyranny.name: Tyranny
tyranny.theme: Domination through force and ego — the dark unity of pride and wrath.

1.effect: Enemies who witness you deliver a killing blow must make a Resolve check or become Cowering for L rounds.

3.effect: Assert total dominance — all enemies within L×20 ft make a Resolve check vs your HP maximum or become Suppressed for L rounds. Suppressed enemies cannot use abilities above T2.

4.effect: Suppressed enemies deal -L damage and -L to all checks. Each Suppressed enemy within range generates +L Concentration stacks for you per round.

5.effect: In your domain (L×25 ft), all effects resolve in your favor first. Suppressed enemies cannot act against you. Your commands count as abilities against those who fail their Resolve check.

avarice.name: Avarice
avarice.theme: Boundless hunger — desire and greed merged into pure acquisitive force.

1.effect: Each resource you hold above normal maximum grants +L to your next roll (stacks additively, max +L²).

3.effect: Each round, automatically drain L SP from the lowest-resource enemy within L×15 ft.

4.effect: Your SP maximum increases by L for each resource type you hold above normal maximum — the ceiling rises with your hunger.

5.effect: You cannot run out of SP while any enemies exist (you drain passively to sustain yourself). All ability costs are halved. Enemies with fewer resources than you are Frightened by your presence.

spite.name: Spite
spite.theme: Vindictive malice — envy sharpened by wrath into a weapon of pure resentment.

1.effect: When you take damage or a negative status, gain L Ambition stacks and L Empower stacks — pain becomes purpose.

3.effect: Vengeful Strike — deals L²×(damage taken this encounter / 10, rounded up) bonus damage. Each use marks this enemy for +L future damage.

4.effect: Enemies who have damaged you suffer -L to all checks as you radiate focused hatred toward them specifically.

5.effect: All damage dealt to enemies who have harmed you is doubled. You cannot be killed by the same enemy twice — stabilize at 1 HP for the first killing blow from each enemy. Your spite outlasts your wounds.

passion.name: Passion
passion.theme: Intense emotional force — desire and fury merged into transcendent expression.

1.effect: Emotions are a furnace. All abilities cost +L AP but deal +L² effect — the intensity is everything.

2.effect: Max SP +L²; Max HP +L². SPR and HPR each +L.

3.effect: Release all held passion in an explosion of energy — deal L² to all enemies in L×15 ft and heal all allies in range for the same amount.

4.effect: While Invigorate and Empower stacks are simultaneously active, all abilities deal +L² damage and effect.

5.effect: Passion cannot be extinguished. Status effects that would reduce your SP or HP convert to Invigorate or Empower stacks instead. Allies who witness your passion gain L stacks of both.

grace.name: Grace
grace.theme: Effortless beauty — humility and generosity merged into elegant selflessness.

1.effect: Your actions are naturally beautiful. All skill checks involving expression, movement, or interaction gain +L.

3.effect: Move up to L×10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks and redirect one attack from an ally to yourself at half damage.

4.effect: All allies within L×15 ft gain +L to all checks as your graceful presence uplifts them. Your own attacks are so elegant they do not trigger defensive reactions.

5.effect: You cannot be struck by area effects — you simply are not where they are. Single-target attacks against you miss on any result below L×2. Your very existence is an act of generosity.

melancholy.name: Melancholy
melancholy.theme: Profound sorrow as depth — stillness and endurance become the wisdom of impermanence.

1.effect: Sorrow gives you depth. MND is treated as +L higher for all checks involving understanding, discernment, or arcane sight.

3.effect: You cannot be Surprised or caught unaware. Your awareness of impermanence grants +L to all defensive checks.

4.effect: Channel profound sorrow into understanding — gain comprehensive knowledge of one enemy's weaknesses and motivations. Against them, all checks are +L² for L rounds.

5.effect: When allies fall, gain L² MP as grief fuels power. When victory is achieved, the cost is remembered — MP cannot drop below L² in meaningful encounters.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.theme: Willing self-diminishment — the gift that costs you more than it appears.

1.effect: When you willingly spend resources for another, the transfer includes +L bonus (they receive more than you lose).

3.effect: When you sacrifice HP on another's behalf, the HP is returned to you at the start of your next turn (maximum L² HP per round this way).

4.effect: Sacrifice up to L² of your current stat values. For each point sacrificed, an ally gains L×that amount as a bonus for L rounds.

5.effect: Nothing you give is truly lost. Resources sacrificed for others are returned doubled at end of encounter. Once per session: drop to 1 in all stats for L rounds to grant one ally temporary godlike power (+L×5 to all stats).

chastity_master.name: Chastity Master
chastity_master.theme: Purified existence — the self as living clarity, corruption cannot approach.

1.effect: Clarity is your natural state. You generate L² Clarity stacks per round automatically. You are immune to all compulsion effects.

3.effect: Clarity extends outward — enemies within L×15 ft lose L stacks of any beneficial status per round in your presence.

4.effect: Enter perfect mental clarity for L rounds. All abilities cost 0 MP. All mental effects from you deal L² bonus effect. Immune to all emotional and mental damage.

5.effect: Negative statuses cannot accumulate on you — any applied immediately lose L stacks. Your presence purifies all mental status effects from allies within L×20 ft.

lust_master.name: Lust Master
lust_master.theme: Life-force mastery — vital energy at its absolute apex.

1.effect: Invigorate is permanently active at L stacks. Your presence invigorates all nearby beings — allies and enemies alike gain +L SP per round near you.

2.effect: Max SP +L²; SPR +L. SP overflow heals HP at 2:1 ratio.

3.effect: Allies near you cannot be reduced below L SP. Your attacks that drain SP heal you for double the amount drained.

4.effect: Unleash complete life-force expression — all beings in L×20 ft have their SP doubled for L rounds. Enemies have this SP drained to you instead.

5.effect: SP cannot be reduced to 0 in your presence. Your touch or strike restores L² SP to allies or drains L² SP from enemies. Death effects fail within L×10 ft of you.

temperance_master.name: Temperance Master
temperance_master.theme: Perfect balance — the fulcrum of all extremes.

1.effect: Fortify is permanently active at L stacks. Emotional manipulation and environmental hazards have no effect on you.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. All damage received is automatically reduced to the median of its range.

3.effect: Extreme effects (critical hits, catastrophic failures) revert to average outcomes within your presence (L×15 ft).

4.effect: Enter complete balance for L rounds — all stats treated as equal and at maximum value, resource costs average to 1 AP for all abilities.

5.effect: Critical hits against you become normal hits. Critical failures by you become normal failures. Once per session, balance any single extreme outcome in the encounter — for allies or enemies.

gluttony_master.name: Gluttony Master
gluttony_master.theme: Infinite capacity — the self as a living void that consumes and transforms everything.

1.effect: You sustain yourself on any energy type. Regenerate grants HP and SP simultaneously.

2.effect: Max SP +L²; Max HP +L². Both regens +L.

3.effect: Each round, drain L of every resource type from every enemy within L×15 ft. These can be held above your maximums indefinitely.

4.effect: Consume the energy of the battlefield itself — drain L² from all enemies and L² from all environmental energy within L×20 ft, then heal all allies for L% of total drained.

5.effect: Your capacity is literally infinite. You cannot be emptied. All incoming effects that would reduce your resources are halved, then transferred to you as restoration.

charity_master.name: Charity Master
charity_master.theme: Divine benevolence — protection that borders on the sacred.

1.effect: Barrier is permanent on all allies within L×10 ft (refreshes each round). When your Barrier absorbs an entire attack, the attacker takes L² reflected damage.

3.effect: Your protection extends to the spirit — allies cannot be reduced to 0 HP by a single attack while within L×15 ft of you.

4.effect: Pour your essence into protection — for L rounds, all damage dealt to allies within L×20 ft comes to you instead, halved. You cannot be killed during this period.

5.effect: Allies you protect are immune to death effects. When you would die, if any ally has taken damage this encounter, you remain at 1 HP instead. Once per session: restore all allies to full HP.

greed_master.name: Greed Master
greed_master.theme: Total acquisition — wealth beyond measure, secured forever.

1.effect: Harden is permanent at L stacks. All resources you hold are magically secured — they cannot be drained, stolen, or destroyed.

2.effect: Max SP +L²; SPR +L. Allies within L×10 ft gain +L SP per round from proximity to your wealth aura.

3.effect: At the start of each encounter, your SP is automatically at maximum. All SP and MP held by enemies above their base is accessible to you as a secondary pool.

4.effect: Transform L² of your SP into permanent stat bonuses until end of session (+1 per 10 SP spent, distributed freely among your stats).

5.effect: Your SP pool has no functional maximum. You accumulate L SP per round passively. SP stolen by enemies returns to you within L rounds.

patience_master.name: Patience Master
patience_master.theme: Absolute endurance — what the mountain will do is inevitable.

1.effect: Hasten is permanent at L stacks. Your HP cannot drop below L% of maximum from any single attack.

3.effect: You declare your intended action for next round immediately — it happens regardless of any enemy interference or interruption.

4.effect: Declare a target outcome. For L rounds, nothing can prevent this outcome — it automatically succeeds at the end of the duration.

5.effect: Abilities you begin casting cannot be interrupted. Your maximum HP is treated as your actual HP for all defensive calculations — the mountain's size is its defense.

wrath_master.name: Wrath Master
wrath_master.theme: Unstoppable destruction — wrath elevated to a force of nature.

1.effect: Empower is permanent at L stacks. Enemies who have faced you before are Frightened on sight.

2.effect: Max HP +L²; HPR +L. Each hit you deal adds L permanent Empower stacks (until end of session).

3.effect: Your attacks cannot be parried, blocked, or reduced by defensive abilities — only raw HP stands between your strikes and death.

4.effect: Unleash righteous destruction for L rounds — double all damage dealt, all attacks are automatic hits, area abilities cost 0 AP.

5.effect: Your anger is a force of nature — enemies without Empower stacks take +L² extra damage from you. Killing blows release a shockwave dealing L² damage to all enemies within L×10 ft.

diligence_master.name: Diligence Master
diligence_master.theme: Perfect craft — everything you do is at the edge of what is possible.

1.effect: Alert is permanent at maximum stacks. You can perfectly replicate any ability you have observed L or more times this session.

3.effect: Any extended task (5+ rounds) automatically succeeds at the highest possible outcome with L% improvement on top.

4.effect: Declare a Masterwork Action requiring L rounds to complete — upon completion, the effect is L²× more powerful than any normal version.

5.effect: Everything you do is masterwork. Ability effects are maximized. All checks succeed on 1+. Once per session, declare any action a Grand Masterwork — it achieves its theoretical maximum effect.

sloth_master.name: Sloth Master
sloth_master.theme: Complete economy — stillness as supreme authority.

1.effect: Bolstered is permanent at L stacks. You need 0 AP to maintain concentration or sustain ongoing effects.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. Your natural recovery rate triples while inactive for 1 round.

3.effect: All abilities costing 2+ AP cost L fewer AP. Your passive defenses equal your maximum active defenses.

4.effect: Enter total conservation mode for L rounds — 0 AP cost for all actions, all defenses maximize, stillness is complete power.

5.effect: You recover L² MP per round. Enemies suffer -L to all checks in your presence. Allies recover L HP/SP per round from your calming aura. Once per session, your stillness ends an encounter — nothing more needs to happen.

generosity_master.name: Generosity Master
generosity_master.theme: Infinite abundance — the source that gives more than it has.

1.effect: Inspiration is permanent at L stacks for all allies within L×15 ft. Your abundance is endless.

2.effect: Max SP +L²; SPR +L. All resources you distribute are doubled — you give more than you have.

3.effect: You can give resources you don't possess — go negative on SP and MP to benefit allies. Debt is forgiven at encounter's end.

4.effect: Create an abundance field in L×25 ft for L rounds. All allies recover L² SP per round and treat all resources as unlimited.

5.effect: You are a living wellspring. Resources are infinite within your presence. Allies with you cannot run out of SP. All SP given to allies returns to you at the start of your next round.

envy_master.name: Envy Master
envy_master.theme: Complete understanding of lack — the wanting has consumed all limitation.

1.effect: Ambition stacks grow whenever any being within L×40 ft succeeds at anything. You have perfect awareness of all stats and abilities in range.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. Each 5 Ambition stacks grants +1 to all your stats permanently until end of session.

3.effect: Any being with something you don't have grants +L² attack bonus against them — the wanting is power made real.

4.effect: Identify and copy the highest ability of any L beings within range. These copies function at your level and last until end of session.

5.effect: You are now the object of envy — all beings feel the pull toward you. Enemies lose L to all checks near you. Once per session: become everything you have envied — temporarily gain all abilities you have observed this session.

humility_master.name: Humility Master
humility_master.theme: Complete self-transcendence — the empty vessel that holds everything.

1.effect: Flow is permanent at L stacks. Others' strengths flow through you — you are the conduit for all power.

3.effect: Your presence increases all ally stats by L. Your own stats appear as 1 — yet all checks succeed because the universe acts through you.

4.effect: For L rounds, completely efface yourself — multiply all ally stats by L instead of your own. Enemies cannot perceive you as a target.

5.effect: By having nothing, you are everything. You cannot be reduced below 1 in any stat. Your support grants allies +L² to all checks. When enemies attempt to diminish you, they fail and take L damage.

pride_master.name: Pride Master
pride_master.theme: Supreme self-actualization — the self as an undeniable statement of reality.

1.effect: Concentration is permanent at L stacks. All beings within L×30 ft are aware of your reputation and deeds.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. Enemies suffer -L to all checks against you.

3.effect: Declare your absolute superiority — all enemies within L×25 ft make a Resolve check (DC = your level × 5) or become Awed for L rounds. Awed enemies cannot target you directly.

4.effect: Your existence is a statement. All checks against your stats automatically resolve in your favor. All plots against you reveal themselves within L rounds.

5.effect: Your stats are treated as 5 higher. You cannot fail. Once per session, your presence alone resolves a conflict — your reputation and will are sufficient.

catharsis.name: Catharsis
catharsis.theme: The profound release that follows total emotional expression — the great clearing before transcendence.

prerequisite.note: Any two T3 compound states at L3 or higher.

1.effect: You have experienced the fullness of emotional depth. Your L² most recent emotional status stacks serve as fuel for all abilities.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; Max SP +L²; Max HP +L². All regens +L.

3.effect: Total Release — purge all status stacks (positive and negative) from yourself. Convert their total to L²× bonus damage on your next action and full resource restoration.

4.effect: Negative statuses on you automatically convert to equivalent positive statuses at the rate of L per round.

5.effect: The Great Clearing — release the full emotional weight of this session. Deal damage equal to all HP lost this session to all enemies within L×30 ft. Restore all allies to full HP. Enter the next encounter with all pools at maximum.

dominion.name: Dominion
dominion.theme: Complete emotional mastery — directing any emotional current like a river.

1.effect: Emotional currents are visible to you and manipulable. You can see, intensify, or dampen any emotional state within L×20 ft.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; Max SP +L². MPR and SPR each +L.

3.effect: Restructure the emotional landscape of L×25 ft for L rounds — choose whether the area intensifies or dampens all emotional states, and by how much.

4.effect: Force the emotional state of all beings within L×20 ft to a chosen emotion for L rounds. They experience this authentically — it is not illusion.

5.effect: Rewrite the emotional history of an encounter — all NPCs and enemies re-evaluate their motivations based on the emotion you instill.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.theme: The unification of opposites — virtue and vice recognized as aspects of a single truth.

prerequisite.note: Any T3 bridge deepening at L4 and any T3 compound state at L4.

1.effect: You perceive the unity underlying apparent opposites. Virtues and vices no longer conflict within you — they complement.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; Max SP +L²; Max HP +L². All regens +L.

3.effect: Choose any two opposing virtues/vices you hold. Their status effects stack together for doubled benefit as long as you hold both.

4.effect: Harmonic Convergence — for L rounds, all your abilities draw from unified emotional truth. Effect of all abilities is doubled; resource costs halved.

5.effect: You contain all emotional truth. Gain the benefits of all L1 emotional statuses simultaneously at L stacks each, refreshed each round (Clarity, Invigorate, Fortify, Regenerate, Barrier, Harden, Hasten, Empower, Focus, Bolstered, Ambition, Flow, Inspiration, Concentration).

enlightenment.name: Enlightenment
enlightenment.theme: Clear perception of emotional truth — the stillness from which transcendence becomes possible.

prerequisite.note: Any two different T3 solo adepts at L5.

1.effect: Your emotional clarity extends to metaphysical perception. You sense the emotional state of all beings within L×30 ft without any detection.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. External status effects lose half their duration on you.

3.effect: Allies within L×15 ft gain +L to all checks as your clarity illuminates the path forward.

4.effect: Enter perfect emotional clarity for L rounds. All abilities originating from this clarity automatically achieve their highest possible effect.

5.effect: You stand at the edge of complete transcendence. Transcendence costs 0 additional affinity points for you. Your MND is treated as 5 higher for all emotional affinity calculations.

apotheosis.name: Apotheosis
apotheosis.theme: The moment before total transcendence — the self fully realized, all emotion embraced.

prerequisite.note: Any three T4 entries (solo masters or compound states) at L5.

1.effect: You stand at the boundary between mortal feeling and divine perspective. All emotional effects you originate are treated as one tier higher.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; Max SP +L²; Max HP +L². All regens +L².

3.effect: All emotional affinities you possess have their effective level treated as L higher.

4.effect: You automatically understand the motivations, fears, and desires of any being you interact with. This grants +L² to all social and combat checks against them.

5.effect: Briefly touch Transcendence — for L rounds, gain all Level 5 benefits of every emotional affinity you hold simultaneously.

transcendence.name: Transcendence
transcendence.theme: Full integration of the emotional spectrum. Neither ruled by virtue nor vice, the Transcendent understands why both exist and is no longer bound by either.

prerequisite.description: Seven or more Emotional Affinities known, including at least one T2 Bridge Affinity.

1.effect: Emotional effects (Charm, Fear, Inspire, Intimidate, etc.) cannot be applied to you without your consent.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; Max SP +L²; MPR +L; SPR +L.

3.effect: Once per round, shift any emotional status effect on an ally or enemy to a different target within L×15 ft — including beneficial ones.

4.effect: Your emotional affinities no longer conflict. You may hold opposing virtue/vice pairs simultaneously without Bridge Affinity prerequisites.

5.effect: Radiate Equanimity: allies within L×20 ft are immune to Fear, Charm, and morale penalties. Once per rest, remove all emotional conditions from all allies in range.

chastity_paragon.name: Chastity Paragon
chastity_paragon.theme: Artemis — the untouched divine, purity as a field that cannot be entered uninvited.

1.effect: Your purity is a field. All corrupting effects fail within L×20 ft. You purify contaminated water, minds, and spaces by proximity.

3.effect: Cleanse all negative effects from L targets. Their mental stats are restored to maximum. Each receives L² Clarity stacks.

4.effect: You are immune to all negative mental and emotional effects. Your MND cannot be reduced. Allies within L×20 ft share half your immunity.

5.effect: Purify any environment, person, or situation — removing all negative emotional and mental effects from an entire scene permanently.

lust_paragon.name: Lust Paragon
lust_paragon.theme: Eros — divine desire, the force of attraction at the heart of all creation.

1.effect: You are the personification of desire. All beings within L×20 ft feel an inexorable pull toward you. You may direct this pull freely.

3.effect: Send a bolt of pure desire at one target — they become genuinely devoted to a chosen being or cause for L rounds (not compulsion — authentic feeling).

4.effect: All beings within L×25 ft recover L SP per round from your presence. Death effects fail entirely within this radius.

5.effect: Direct the fundamental desire of all beings in a scene — choose what they most want, and they pursue it genuinely for the remainder of the session.

temperance_paragon.name: Temperance Paragon
temperance_paragon.theme: Sophrosyne — the divine principle of right measure, cosmic balance made manifest.

1.effect: You embody cosmic moderation. Extremes cannot exist near you — all things trend toward balance in your presence.

3.effect: Establish perfect balance in a L×25 ft area for L rounds. All effects (damage, healing, resources) are averaged across all beings in the area.

4.effect: You cannot be moved to extremes by any means. All stats are always at their optimal value. Critical hits against you become normal hits.

5.effect: The eternal scale speaks — redistribute any outcome perfectly. Damage becomes healing, failure becomes success, excess becomes sufficiency. The universe itself balances around your judgment.

gluttony_paragon.name: Gluttony Paragon
gluttony_paragon.theme: Dionysus — the divine feast, infinite abundance, the cosmic celebration of excess.

1.effect: You are plenty itself. Resources cannot be depleted in your presence — all pools refill at L² per round.

2.effect: Max SP +L²×2; Max HP +L². Both regens +L².

3.effect: Hold a bacchic feast of pure energy in L×25 ft — all beings restore full HP and SP, all abilities cost 0 resources for L rounds.

4.effect: Your presence is intoxicating. All beings near you gain +L to all actions (including enemies). The excess is contagious — and glorious.

5.effect: Scarcity does not exist near you. All resource pools are treated as full within L×20 ft. End all negative resource effects in a scene — everyone has what they need.

charity_paragon.name: Charity Paragon
charity_paragon.theme: Agape — divine love as pure gift, the love that asks nothing and gives everything.

1.effect: You are unconditional giving. All healing you provide is doubled and costs you nothing. You gain resources from the act of giving.

3.effect: Bestow divine grace on all allies within L×20 ft — full HP and SP restoration, all negative statuses removed, L² stacks of all positive statuses granted.

4.effect: You cannot be reduced below 1 HP while any being needs your protection. Damage you sacrifice yourself for is always halved.

5.effect: Agape made manifest — end all hostilities in a scene through pure love. All beings experience genuine healing. Enemies must actively choose to continue fighting.

greed_paragon.name: Greed Paragon
greed_paragon.theme: Midas — the divine hoard, acquisition elevated to cosmic principle.

1.effect: Everything you possess becomes more valuable. Items you carry are worth L× more. Resources accumulate interest at L per round.

3.effect: Target one enemy or object. Their HP maximum becomes your SP — they are worth exactly that much. Against them, deal bonus damage equal to their HP total.

4.effect: You cannot lose resources permanently. Everything lost returns within L rounds. Your SP is treated as L²× its actual value for all calculations.

5.effect: The golden throne — acquire anything of material value that exists within the session's scope. It comes to you.

patience_paragon.name: Patience Paragon
patience_paragon.theme: Prometheus — eternal endurance, patience that spans ages and outlasts all opposition.

1.effect: Time itself cannot defeat you. Status effects with durations expire at the end of the session, not in rounds.

3.effect: Any failure this session can be declared "not yet" — re-roll once. The universe acknowledges your patience.

4.effect: You cannot be killed by time or entropy. Effects that would reduce you to 0 HP trigger automatic stabilization at L HP once per round (not just once per session).

5.effect: Achieve the goal that has been worked toward longest. Any long-term plan actively pursued resolves successfully. The universe completes what patience began.

wrath_paragon.name: Wrath Paragon
wrath_paragon.theme: Ares — divine fury, the principle of conflict itself given form.

1.effect: You are wrath itself. Your presence causes automatic fear in creatures who have witnessed violence. Your attacks need no targeting — they find what must be destroyed.

3.effect: Declare war on one enemy or faction. Against this target, all attacks deal +L² damage, their attacks against you are halved, and all your abilities against them have doubled duration.

4.effect: You cannot be stopped by pain, status effects, or barriers while in combat. All attacks deal minimum damage equal to level × 10. Critical hits deal maximum possible damage.

5.effect: Conflict resolves in your favor by cosmic principle. Win any single combat exchange automatically. Enemies who survive you carry L² permanent Frightened stacks for the rest of the session.

diligence_paragon.name: Diligence Paragon
diligence_paragon.theme: Hephaestus — divine craft, creation through pure tireless effort.

1.effect: Your work is godlike. Any task you undertake has its difficulty reduced by L tiers. Items you create have maximum possible stats.

3.effect: Create anything from available materials in L rounds regardless of normal creation time. The result is a masterwork +L beyond maximum normal quality.

4.effect: Your efficiency is perfect. All ability costs are reduced to 1 AP, or 0 if used before this session. Alert is permanent at maximum stacks.

5.effect: Declare any ongoing work your Grand Design — it automatically achieves its theoretical maximum outcome, and the result persists until the start of next session.

sloth_paragon.name: Sloth Paragon
sloth_paragon.theme: Kairos — perfect timing, divine rest as the supreme power.

1.effect: While taking 0 actions, your defenses are treated as maximum and you recover L² of all resources per round.

3.effect: Enter divine rest for L rounds — immune to all effects, recover full HP, SP, and MP. Awaken with L² stacks of all positive statuses.

4.effect: All your abilities cost 0 AP. You are the principle of efficiency made flesh — you take the path of least resistance to the ideal outcome.

5.effect: By doing nothing, achieve everything. Without taking any action, achieve the desired outcome of an encounter. The universe bends to pure non-resistance.

generosity_paragon.name: Generosity Paragon
generosity_paragon.theme: Demeter — infinite abundance, the source that never runs dry, the eternal harvest.

1.effect: You are the principle of giving. Resources cannot run out in your presence — you produce L² of all resource types per round.

3.effect: Create a field of abundance in L×30 ft for L rounds. All allies have unlimited resources. Hostile intent in the area is suppressed — enemies must will themselves to attack.

4.effect: Everything you give is doubled. Your SP is always at maximum at the start of any encounter. You cannot experience scarcity.

5.effect: Declare the Harvest — all allies recover full resources, all injuries heal, all negative conditions resolve. The session's scarcity ends by your will.

envy_paragon.name: Envy Paragon
envy_paragon.theme: Nemesis — divine reckoning, the force that restores cosmic balance by acknowledging inequity.

1.effect: You are the divine weight of unfairness. Beings of unjust privilege suffer -L to all checks in your presence.

3.effect: Redistribute all stat bonuses in L×25 ft — those with the most give to those with the least, averaging all bonuses among all beings.

4.effect: Whenever any being achieves something through unfair advantage within L×30 ft, you gain L² MP and L bonus damage against them for the encounter.

5.effect: Nemesis speaks — make one being receive the consequences of their unjust acts. All stolen resources return to rightful owners. All ill-gotten advantages dissolve permanently.

humility_paragon.name: Humility Paragon
humility_paragon.theme: Hestia — the sacred hearth, the sustaining presence that asks for nothing and holds everything.

1.effect: You are the hearth fire — the sustaining presence that asks nothing. All allies within L×20 ft regenerate L of all resources per round.

3.effect: Establish a sanctuary in L×25 ft for L rounds. Within it, healing is doubled, attacks are halved, allies gain +L to all checks, enemies gain -L to all checks.

4.effect: By having no needs of your own, you have everything others need. All your support and healing is maximized. Enemies cannot perceive you as a threat unless you attack them first.

5.effect: Become home for all present — all allies are instantly restored and feel complete safety. All enemies make a supreme Resolve check or leave the fight entirely.

pride_paragon.name: Pride Paragon
pride_paragon.theme: Zeus — the supreme will, divine ego that shapes reality by declaring it.

1.effect: Your will is cosmic law. Declarations you make about reality have a L×10% chance of manifesting immediately (GM adjudicates).

3.effect: The Thunderbolt — declare one truth about this encounter. It manifests. An enemy falls, an obstacle yields, an ally succeeds.

4.effect: Your word is law. Commands given to beings of lower level cannot be refused. Your presence causes all lesser beings to defer.

5.effect: You are the King of the Gods. Declare any outcome for the session and it comes to pass within narrative reason. The universe yields to the summit of pride.

1.effect: On Hit: Apply L stacks of Crushed.

2.effect: MPR +L. Resist Earth L. Regain L MP when hit by Earth damage.

3.effect: Earthen defense grants +L Block. Regain L HP when Blocking.

4.effect: Reduce push/pull distance by L ft. +L to saves vs forced movement or knockdown.

5.effect: Ignore L Crushed per round. Earth damage reduced by L. Immune to terrain penalties. Adjacent allies gain +L Block.

status_pool.notes: Earth utility makes the user more stable — not controlling enemies but refusing to be moved.

1.effect: On Hit: Apply L stacks of Chilled.

2.effect: MPR +L. Resist Water L. Regain L MP when hit by Water damage.

3.effect: -L stacks when receiving Burned. Gain L MP when healing others.

4.effect: No penalty on wet or icy terrain. -L Chilled stacks received. +L vs Grapple and Restrain.

5.effect: Water damage reduced by L. Start of turn: remove 1 Burned or Bleeding. Allies healed by you in 5 ft gain +L MP.

status_pool.identity: Flow and memory. Adaptive, receptive, persistent.
status_pool.notes: Memory mechanics emerge at higher tiers. T1 Water expresses through viscosity and flow.

1.effect: On Hit: Apply L stacks of Burned.

2.effect: MPR +L. Resist Fire L. Regain L MP when hit by Fire damage.

3.effect: Burned ignores L resistance. Gain L SP when applying Burned.

4.effect: +L Initiative. -L Chilled stacks received. Gain +L MP when gaining Haste.

5.effect: Fire damage reduced by L. Burned lasts +1 turn. Burned stacks reduce enemy MPR by L.

status_pool.notes: Fire does not add speed — it amplifies intensity. Kindle builds heat stacks that empower the next effect.

1.effect: On Hit: Apply L stacks of Weathered.

2.effect: MPR +L. Resist Air L. Regain L MP when hit by Air damage.

3.effect: +L to Jump, Balance, Evasion. Ignore fall damage up to 10×L ft. Free stand from Prone.

4.effect: +5×L ft move speed. Permanent Haste. Haste stacks trigger an additional AP.

5.effect: Resist being moved by L ft. Weathered reduces SP by L. First move each turn costs 0 AP. +L Dodge and Deflect.

status_pool.identity: Thought and motion. Acts first, moves fast.
status_pool.notes: Air is the element of speed and anticipation. Evasion defense reflects reading the fight before it happens.

blood.name: Blood
blood.theme: All life has water in it.

levels.1: Spend HP for MP at 2:1 ratio. On Hit: apply L stacks of regenerate.
levels.3: Immune to Bleeding. On Hit: heal L and apply a Bleeding stack.
levels.4: Bleeding damage from enemies or allies heals you for half, rounded up.
levels.5: Blood Funnel: Heal all allies, including you in 6 spaces for L HP, and apply L Regenerate to them.

limitations: No effect against constructs, undead, or machines — requires biological fluid to function.

levels.1: Slow stacks you apply count double when determining movement penalty.
levels.2: +L MPR. Resist Ice L. Ice damage taken reduces Burned stacks by L.
levels.3: Cannot be knocked Prone on icy terrain. Slow stacks last +1 turn.
levels.4: Adjacent allies gain +L to defense vs Slowed or Immobilized foes.
levels.5: Ignore all movement penalties from snow, frost, chill. Ice damage heals you for L if not a critical hit.

levels.1: Burned and Crushed you apply deal +L damage if target has both.
levels.2: +L MPR. Resist Fire and Earth L. Regain HP equal to Fire or Earth damage resisted.
levels.3: When you Block or Deflect, deal Fire damage equal to Crushed stacks on attacker.
levels.4: Crushed and Burned stacks reduce target's Block and Dodge rolls by L.
levels.5: Double Burned and Crushed stacks you apply.

levels.1: On hit: Apply +L Blind if target has Crushed or Weathered stacks.
levels.2: +L MPR. Resist Wind and Earth L. Gain L SP when you dodge or deflect.
levels.3: Enemies within 5×L ft have -L to Perception and Ranged attack rolls.
levels.4: Move through hindering terrain at full speed.
levels.5: While obscured, attacks deal +L damage and enemies take -L to defense against your attacks.

firecaller.name: Firecaller
firecaller.theme: The heart of the flame beats within you.

levels.1: Burned stacks you apply deal +1 damage per stack.
levels.3: Burned reduces healing received by L. On hit: apply 1 Vulnerable stack.
levels.4: +L Fire resistance. Burned ticks you apply restore L MP.
levels.5: Burned damage dealt to you heals you instead.

watercaller.name: Watercaller
watercaller.theme: The depth of the ocean is in your soul.

levels.1: Chilled stacks you apply deal +1 damage per stack.
levels.3: Chilled reduces healing received by L. On hit: apply 1 Vulnerable stack.
levels.4: +L Cold resistance. Chilled ticks you apply restore L MP.
levels.5: Chilled damage dealt to you heals you instead.

earthcaller.name: Earthcaller
earthcaller.theme: The strength of the mountain is in your bones.

levels.1: +L defense against Prone, Grappled, or any forced movement.
levels.3: Crushed stacks you apply also reduce Block and Defense by L.
levels.4: Immune to terrain hazards. Crushed stacks restore L MP when applied.
levels.5: Count as 1 size larger for movement and force checks.

aircaller.name: Aircaller
aircaller.theme: The swiftness of the wind is in your limbs.

levels.1: Stagger stacks you apply reduce target initiative by L.
levels.3: Haste grants +1 Dodge per stack. Movement abilities apply 1 Stagger on hit.
levels.4: On hit: apply L Stagger stacks. At L Stagger stacks, target loses 1 AP on their next turn.
levels.5: Immune to fall damage. Can act and attack while airborne. Haste stacks grant +L MP per round.

steam.name: Steam
steam.theme: Where fire meets water, pressure transforms both.

levels.1: When you deal Fire damage to a target that has Chilled stacks, create a steam burst — all targets within L×5 ft take L damage and receive 1 Burned + 1 Chilled stack.
levels.3: Steam Cloud — 2 AP, L×5 MP: create an L×10 ft steam cloud for L rounds. Targets inside are Obscured (−L to attack and defense rolls). Allies inside gain +L to stealth.
levels.4: Scalding Mist — steam you create deals L additional fire damage per round to enemies inside.
levels.5: Pressure Cooker — once per rest, compress steam in L×10 ft radius to explosive force. Deal L² combined fire+water damage, apply L Burned + L Chilled, and knock all targets Prone.

storm.name: Storm

levels.1: When you gain Haste, immediately move 5×L ft as a free action.
levels.2: +L MPR. Resist Lightning L. Regain L SP when struck by Lightning damage.
levels.3: Haste grants an extra +1 AP when triggered.
levels.4: Lightning damage ignores shields and barriers.
levels.5: Haste stacks cannot be removed by enemy effects. Lightning damage you take grants +L MP instead. Move actions cost -1 AP but double SP cost.

storm.theme: Fire and air collide — electricity is just the visible proof.

levels.1: +L to Resistance vs Fire and Earth. Burned and Crushed you receive deal -L damage.
levels.2: +L MPR. Regain L MP when taking Fire or Earth damage.
levels.3: Your Burned and Crushed stacks gain +L duration and reduce enemy movement by 5×L ft.
levels.4: +L to checks resisting terrain-based or environmental damage.
levels.5: Regen L HP per round on natural terrain. Your Fire and Earth effects are not resisted by terrain protections.

levels.1: When you apply Slow or Crushed, also reduce target's Dodge by L.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when successfully resisting forced movement or status effects.
levels.3: Allies within 10×L ft ignore the first Slow or Crushed stack each round.
levels.4: +L to all Awareness and Balance checks.
levels.5: Once per round, when an ally within 10 ft succeeds a Defense roll, you gain L MP and +1 Focus.

levels.1: +L to resist Burned, Encumber, and Slowed.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L HP when an ability affects at least two targets.
levels.3: On AoE spell activation, gain +L Temp HP.
levels.4: +L to Diplomacy and Nature-related skills.
levels.5: Environmental AoE effects persist 1 extra turn. Allies inside heal L per round.

levels.1: Crushed and Burned you apply also reduce MP regeneration by L.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L HP when enemies fail movement-based checks.
levels.3: Ignore terrain damage. Move across lava, rockslides, or debris at full speed.
levels.4: Enemies in direct contact with terrain take +L environmental damage each round.
levels.5: Gain Tremor Sense. Burned and Crushed stacks you apply spread to 1 adjacent enemy per round.

levels.1: Halve Slow and Burned stacks applied to you.
levels.2: +L MPR. Regain L MP on hit of target with Chilled or Slow stacks.
levels.3: +L to attack rolls vs targets with both Chilled and Slow.
levels.4: Ice effects reduce enemy Dodge by L and Speed by L×5 ft.
levels.5: Immune to Chilled and Slow. Targets you Freeze gain Burned ×L when they act.

levels.1: Obscuring effects grant +L Stealth. +L attack while Obscured.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when fog or concealment prevents damage to you or ally.
levels.3: Steam terrain effects heal allies in them for L HP per round.
levels.4: Steam illusions count as +L higher tier for resistance purposes.
levels.5: Always considered in cover. +L Defense when obscured.

levels.1: Burned and Crushed stacks you apply reduce target max HP by L.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when Burned or Crushed enemy is incapacitated.
levels.3: Enemies take +L Fire damage if they end their turn Crushed.
levels.4: Gain +L to Earth and Fire Resistance. Standing in lava grants +L Regen.
levels.5: Your Burned and Crushed stacks are immune to cleansing for 1 round after applied.

levels.1: Burned stacks you apply increase Haste by L instead of lowering it.
levels.2: +L MPR. Regain L MP when target gains both Haste and Burned from your ability.
levels.3: Burned stacks on enemies cause them to lose 1 AP if they attempt movement.
levels.4: Haste grants +L to Initiative and Evasion rolls.
levels.5: Burned stacks applied by Haste-triggered effects deal +L bonus damage.

levels.1: Ignore movement penalties from rough, sandy, or broken terrain.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when enemies miss due to terrain penalties.
levels.3: Crushed and Slow stacks applied within terrain you control gain +1 additional stack.
levels.4: Create Dust terrain in 10×L ft radius once per short rest as a free action.
levels.5: Always count as concealed when standing on natural ground.

levels.1: Walk across shallow water and swim without penalty.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when removing Slow, Crushed, or Encumber from an ally.
levels.3: Water and Earth damage you deal heals you for L HP.
levels.4: Resist movement manipulation while touching water or stone.
levels.5: Immune to being Prone, Grappled, or Restrained when standing on natural terrain.

fireshaper.name: Fireshaper
fireshaper.theme: Fire bends to your will — you sculpt it as easily as thought.

levels.1: Your fire effects chain — Burned stacks you apply jump to a second target within L×10 ft for free.
levels.3: Kindle stacks you generate count as double when empowering the next fire ability.
levels.4: Redirect active Burned stacks from any target within L×20 ft to another target as a free action once per round.
levels.5: Sculpted Flame — once per rest, change a fire ability mid-cast: alter its target, split it into L smaller effects with equal total damage, or double its radius.

watershaper.name: Watershaper
watershaper.theme: Water answers your intent before you have spoken it.

levels.1: Chilled stacks you apply also reduce the target's attack accuracy by L.
levels.3: Redirect — when hit by an attack, spend L MP to redirect half the damage to an adjacent enemy. Once per round.
levels.4: Slow stacks you apply also halve the target's AP regeneration for L rounds.
levels.5: Memory of Water — once per rest, recall the exact position, HP, and status conditions of all creatures within L×30 ft from L rounds ago. You may act on this information for L rounds.

earthshaper.name: Earthshaper
earthshaper.theme: The ground reshapes itself beneath your hands.

levels.1: Shape stone and earth within L×20 ft as an action — create walls, ramps, or pits up to L×5 ft in any dimension.
levels.3: Barrier stacks you apply have +L maximum and absorb +L damage per stack.
levels.4: Seismic Slam — 2 AP: stomp the ground, all targets within L×15 ft must resist or take L Crushed stacks and are knocked Prone.
levels.5: Earthen Fortress — once per rest, raise permanent earthworks (L×30 ft wall or equivalent structure) as a 2 AP action.

airshaper.name: Airshaper
airshaper.theme: The wind speaks your intentions before you act.

levels.1: Gain L additional ft of movement per Haste stack you hold. Stagger stacks you apply reduce enemy initiative by L.
levels.3: Wind Redirect — once per round, redirect any projectile or ranged attack passing within L×10 ft of you to a new target within L×20 ft.
levels.4: Anticipation — you cannot be Surprised. Once per combat, act in the first initiative slot regardless of your roll result.
levels.5: Thought Wind — once per rest, send a message on the wind to anyone you know within L miles and receive a reply if they choose. In combat, read all enemy declared actions for L rounds before they occur.

primalflux.name: PrimalFlux
primalflux.theme: The convergence of all four base elements into a unified elemental awareness. Not mastery of any single element but understanding of the force that connects all of them.

1.effect: All stacking elemental effects (Burned, Chilled, Crushed, Stagger, etc.) you apply gain +1 stack on application.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. Regain L MP per round while you have 3 or more active elemental affinities.

3.effect: AoE elemental abilities gain +L to range or radius.

4.effect: When using an elemental ability, ignore L points of its resource cost for each T1 element you know at Level 3+.

5.effect: Immune to non-critical environmental elemental damage. Elemental stacking effects you apply cannot be resisted or cleansed by base resistances.

firemaster.name: Firemaster
firemaster.theme: Fire is no longer something you command — it is something you are.

levels.1: Immune to environmental fire damage. Burned stacks on you grant +L MP instead of dealing damage.
levels.3: Conflagration — 2 AP, L×5 MP: deal L² fire damage in L×10 ft radius, apply L Burned and L Kindle stacks to all targets hit.
levels.4: When you release Kindle stacks, they deal +L² bonus damage per stack consumed.
levels.5: Living Flame — once per rest, summon a flame construct (HP = L×10, deals L Burned on hit) that acts on your initiative for L rounds.

watermaster.name: Watermaster
watermaster.theme: Water flows through you as readily as through a river.

levels.1: Immune to Chilled damage. Chilled stacks on you restore L MP each round instead.
