levels.3: Torrent — 2 AP, L×5 MP: create a L×20 ft line of rushing water. All targets take L² water damage, apply L Chilled and L Slow stacks, and are pushed L×5 ft.
levels.4: Chilled and Slow you apply cannot be cleansed for L rounds after application.
levels.5: Deep Memory — once per rest, rewind your own actions up to L rounds. You retain full memory of the erased events. Cannot undo death.

earthmaster.name: Earthmaster
earthmaster.theme: The earth obeys you as an extension of your own body.

levels.1: Cannot be knocked Prone, Pushed, or Restrained by any effect of L tier or lower. Terrain damage is ignored.
levels.3: Mountain's Weight — 2 AP, L×5 MP: deal L² earth damage in L×10 ft radius, apply L Crushed and L Fortified stacks, terrain in the area becomes impassable for L rounds.
levels.4: Fortified stacks you apply last twice as long. While Fortified, gain +L to all resistance checks.
levels.5: Living Stone — once per rest, transform your body to stone for L rounds. Gain L×20 Temp HP, immunity to piercing and slashing damage, and deal L Crushed stacks on any melee contact.

airmaster.name: Airmaster
airmaster.theme: You and the wind are no longer separate things.

levels.1: Always considered to have Haste active. Haste stacks grant +L to Dodge and Deflect rolls.
levels.3: Tempest Strike — 2 AP, L×5 MP: strike all enemies within L×15 ft radius, deal L² air damage, apply L Stagger stacks, move each target L×5 ft in any direction you choose.
levels.4: Perfect Evasion — once per round, automatically succeed on one Dodge roll without rolling.
levels.5: Whirlwind Form — once per rest, become a cyclone for L rounds. Melee attacks against you miss except on a critical. You deal L Stagger stacks on any melee contact. Movement speed doubled.

steammaster.name: Steammaster
steammaster.theme: You command the threshold between fire and water — pressure itself obeys you.

levels.1: Steam terrain you create lasts +L rounds. Enemies inside steam zones take L Burned and L Chilled per round.
levels.3: Scalding Burst — 2 AP, L×5 MP: release superheated steam in L×15 ft radius. Deal L² combined fire+water damage, apply L Burned + L Chilled + Obscured to all targets.
levels.4: State Change — shift active steam into ice or fire effects at will, reapplying appropriate stacks to all targets within the area.
levels.5: Pressure Chamber — once per rest, create an L×20 ft zone of extreme pressure steam for L rounds. Targets inside take L² damage per round and cannot see beyond 5 ft. Allies inside gain +L MP per round.

magmamaster.name: Magmamaster
magmamaster.theme: The earth melts and reforms at your will.

levels.1: Crushed and Burned stacks you apply deal +L combined damage per round.
levels.3: Magma Surge — 2 AP, L×5 MP: erupt L×10 ft zone of lava. Deal L² fire+earth damage, apply L Burned + L Crushed, terrain becomes impassable lava for L rounds.
levels.4: Volcanic Armor — gain +L to all physical defenses. When hit in melee, deal L Burned + L Crushed to the attacker.
levels.5: Caldera — once per rest, volcanic eruption in L×30 ft radius. Deal L³ damage, apply maximum Burned and Crushed stacks, terrain permanently scorched (fire effects deal +L damage in this area thereafter).

stormmaster.name: Stormmaster
stormmaster.theme: You are the eye that conjures the storm.

levels.1: Storm effects you apply that trigger Stagger also apply L Burned to the same target.
levels.3: Thunderstrike — 2 AP, L×5 MP: call a bolt of lightning in a L×20 ft line, deal L² damage, apply L Stagger + L Burned, chain to L additional targets within L×10 ft for half damage.
levels.4: Storm Speed — gain +L AP when you have both Haste and Burned active on any nearby target simultaneously.
levels.5: Supercell — once per rest, conjure a raging storm in L×40 ft radius for L rounds. Deal L² damage per round, apply L Stagger + L Burned per round. Allies inside gain +L Haste stacks per round.

icemaster.name: Icemaster
icemaster.theme: Cold is not a state you create — it is your natural condition.

levels.1: Slow and Stagger stacks you apply stack together — a target with both takes +L² penalty to all movement and actions.
levels.3: Blizzard — 2 AP, L×5 MP: create a L×20 ft blizzard for L rounds. All targets take L² ice damage per round, apply L Chilled + L Stagger per round.
levels.4: Absolute Zero — once per short rest, freeze one target solid. They are Stunned and take L² damage when thawed (after L rounds or L² force damage breaks them free).
levels.5: Glacial Dominion — once per rest, flash-freeze L×40 ft radius. All targets become Frozen (Stunned + Restrained), terrain becomes difficult ice for L rounds. Allies are immune.

dustmaster.name: Dustmaster
dustmaster.theme: Everything erodes. You simply accelerate the process.

levels.1: Crushed and Stagger stacks you apply also reduce enemy visibility — targets with both cannot see beyond L×5 ft.
levels.3: Dust Devil — 2 AP, L×5 MP: conjure a whirlwind of debris in L×15 ft radius for L rounds. Deal L² damage per round, apply L Crushed + L Stagger, blind targets inside.
levels.4: Terrain Mastery — alter terrain in L×20 ft radius once per round as a free action (raise dust, shift sand, move loose earth).
levels.5: Sandstorm — once per rest, summon a massive sandstorm in L×50 ft radius for L rounds. All targets inside: Blinded, take L² per round, apply L Crushed + L Stagger. Allies inside have truesight.

bloodmaster.name: Bloodmaster
bloodmaster.theme: Every living thing is a river you can redirect.
limitations: No effect against constructs, undead, or machines — requires biological fluid to function.

levels.1: Bleeding and Regenerate stacks you apply are doubled. Biological targets at maximum Bleeding cannot use active abilities.
levels.3: Hemorrhage — 2 AP, L×5 MP: target one biological creature within L×20 ft. Apply L² Bleeding stacks; you heal for half the bleeding damage dealt each round. Lasts L rounds.
levels.4: Life Flow — once per round, transfer Regenerate stacks from one target to another within L×20 ft as a free action.
levels.5: Blood Tide — once per rest, pull all biological fluid in L×30 ft radius. All biological targets take L² damage, receive maximum Bleeding, and are pulled L×10 ft toward you. You heal for total damage dealt.

thermaflux_artisan.name: Thermaflux Artisan
thermaflux_artisan.theme: Heat, water, and stone become a single instrument in your hands.

levels.1: Sense thermal gradients within L×60 ft — know exact temperatures, heat sources, and thermal weak points in all structures.
levels.3: Geothermal Surge — 2 AP, L×5 MP: deal L² damage as fire, earth, or water (choose each use), apply 2 stacks each of Burned, Crushed, and Chilled to all targets in L×20 ft.
levels.4: Enemies hit by your abilities lose L to all resistance checks for L rounds from the pressure of multiple conflicting thermal states.
levels.5: Thermal Collapse — once per rest, trigger catastrophic heat exchange in L×30 ft. All structural objects take L³ damage. Biological targets take L² and receive L stacks each of Burned, Crushed, and Chilled simultaneously.

spiraflux_artisan.name: Spiraflux Artisan
spiraflux_artisan.theme: Storm is only one word for what you can do with fire, water, and wind.

levels.1: Know exact wind patterns within L×200 ft and predict weather up to L days in advance with complete accuracy.
levels.3: Atmospheric Spiral — 2 AP, L×5 MP: create a spiraling vortex in L×20 ft radius for L rounds. All targets take L² damage (fire+air+water), apply L Stagger + L Burned + L Chilled. The vortex pulls all targets toward its center each round.
levels.4: Storm Riding — travel on atmospheric currents to any location within L×10 miles as a 10-minute action. Cannot be intercepted or tracked by weather effects.
levels.5: Superstorm — once per rest, summon a full atmospheric storm in L×100 ft for L×10 rounds. Rain (L Chilled per round), wind (L Stagger per round), and lightning (L Burned per round) affect all enemies continuously. Allies gain +L to all elemental resistances while inside.

ecoflux_artisan.name: Ecoflux Artisan
ecoflux_artisan.theme: The living world is a system. You are its voice.

levels.1: Sense the health of any natural environment within L×200 ft — living creatures, plant life, water sources, and soil condition are fully readable to you.
levels.3: Natural Resurgence — 2 AP, L×5 MP: restore L² HP to all allies within L×20 ft, apply L Regenerate stacks. Create L×10 ft of lush terrain that grants cover and +L defense to all allies inside.
levels.4: Ecological Balance — once per round, transfer one harmful status effect from an ally to an enemy within L×30 ft as a free action.
levels.5: Biome Shift — once per rest, transform L×50 ft of terrain into thriving wilderness over L rounds. Allies inside: +L² HP regen per round, +L defense. Enemies inside: take L² damage per round from a hostile natural environment.

volcanflux_artisan.name: Volcanflux Artisan
volcanflux_artisan.theme: Eruption is not violence — it is the earth breathing.

levels.1: Sense geological stress points within L×100 ft — detect weaknesses in stone, faultlines, and pressure pockets.
levels.3: Pyroclastic Surge — 2 AP, L×5 MP: launch superheated earth and ash in L×20 ft cone. Deal L² damage (fire+earth+air), apply L Burned + L Crushed + L Stagger. Terrain hit becomes impassable ash field for L rounds.
levels.4: Eruptive Force — your explosive abilities (any with a radius) gain +L to radius and deal +L² damage to all targets in the outer half of the radius.
levels.5: Volcanic Chain — once per rest, trigger a chain eruption. Each L×10 ft zone within L×50 ft erupts sequentially over L rounds, dealing L² damage per zone and applying L Burned + L Crushed stacks. Allies are immune.

aether.name: Aether
aether.theme: Cosmic understanding of how all things are structured and flow at an energetic level. The point where Primal force, Emotional awareness, and Arcane knowledge converge into unified perception of existence.

prerequisite.note: Either PrimalLord at Level 5 (convergence path), or all four T5 solo elements — Firelord, Waterlord, Earthlord, and Airlord — each at Level 5 (four-peak path). Both represent absolute primal mastery.
Either Time or Space at Level 5 satisfies this requirement.

1.effect: Perceive the energetic structure of anything within L×30 ft — read affinities, elemental composition, and emotional state of creatures and objects.

2.effect: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. All resource pools regenerate +L per round.

3.effect: Elemental, emotional, and arcane effects you apply are treated as L levels higher for purposes of stacking, duration, and resistance checks.

4.effect: Once per round, redirect any incoming energy-based effect to a different target within L×10 ft. Does not require a reaction.

5.effect: Aetheric Convergence: once per rest, simultaneously apply the L1 effect of any three affinities you know as a single 3 AP action. Effects resolve fully.

firelord.name: Firelord
firelord.theme: You are the flame itself — the moment before destruction becomes creation.

levels.1: All Burned stacks you apply ignore resistance. Fire damage you deal cannot be reduced below 1 per stack.
levels.3: Rebirth — when reduced to 0 HP, explode in a burst of fire (L² damage, L Burned in L×15 ft radius) and return to L×5 HP. Once per rest.
levels.4: Passion's Crown — your Burned and Kindle stacks have no maximum. Kindle stacks no longer expire naturally.
levels.5: Primordial Pyre — once per session, call down a column of ancient fire. L×20 ft radius, deal L³ fire damage, all targets at maximum Burned stacks, terrain ignites for L rounds. Allies in range heal for L² HP.

waterlord.name: Waterlord
waterlord.theme: You are the tide — ancient, patient, and inevitable.

levels.1: Sense the history of any body of water or creature you touch — know past trauma, significant water events, and current biological state.
levels.3: Tide Call — once per rest, pull all targets within L×30 ft toward you L×5 ft, applying L Chilled and L Slow stacks to each.
levels.4: Memory Current — allies within L×20 ft share access to your Deep Memory ability. You can replay L rounds of memory from any body of water you can see.
levels.5: Primordial Ocean — once per session, summon an L×50 ft zone of ancient water for L rounds. All targets inside: Slowed to 0 move speed, take L² cold damage per round, all Burned stacks removed. Allies inside gain +L² HP regen per round.

earthlord.name: Earthlord
earthlord.theme: The bedrock of the world shifts when you speak.

levels.1: Know exact terrain composition and sense all creatures touching the ground within L×100 ft.
levels.3: Tectonic Shift — once per rest, permanently reshape up to L×100 ft² of terrain. Create chasms, elevate ground, seal caves — effects are permanent.
levels.4: Immovable Object — once per round, negate any forced movement, knockdown, or grapple attempt as a free reaction.
levels.5: Primordial Earth — once per session, cause a seismic event in L×50 ft radius. All enemies take L³ crushing damage, maximum Crushed stacks, and are Restrained (takes L² damage roll to escape each round). Allies gain +L² Barrier stacks.

airlord.name: Airlord
airlord.theme: You move as thought itself — before intention becomes action.

levels.1: Your movement cannot be tracked or intercepted by anything with lower initiative than you. You always know the full initiative order.
levels.3: Cyclone Mastery — once per rest, conjure a L×30 ft tornado for L rounds. All targets inside: Staggered, take L² air damage per round, cannot use ranged attacks.
levels.4: Infinite Haste — Haste stacks have no maximum. Each stack beyond 5 grants +1 additional AP per round.
levels.5: Primordial Wind — once per session, release absolute force in a L×50 ft line. All targets take L³ air damage, maximum Stagger stacks, are hurled L×20 ft, and cannot stand for L rounds. Allies gain maximum Haste stacks and +L² MP.

steamlord.name: Steamlord
steamlord.theme: Matter itself changes state at your preference.

levels.1: Environmental extremes of heat or cold cannot affect you. You exist in perfect thermal balance.
levels.3: Thermokinetic Mastery — shift any L×30 ft zone from extreme heat to extreme cold (or reverse) as a 2 AP action. Frozen terrain flash-melts; dry terrain floods with scalding water.
levels.4: Phase Dominion — alter the physical state of any non-living matter you touch (freeze, melt, vaporize) as a free action.
levels.5: Primordial Steam — once per session, trigger an atmospheric inversion in L×100 ft radius. All temperature-based status effects are cleared then reapplied at maximum stacks (enemies only). Allies gain permanent resistance to fire and cold damage.

magmalord.name: Magmalord
magmalord.theme: The world's molten heart answers to you.

levels.1: Immune to fire and earth damage. Lava and magma terrain restores L HP per round instead of dealing damage.
levels.3: Magma Form — once per rest, transform into living magma for L rounds. All melee attacks deal L Burned + L Crushed. Flow through earth and stone freely. HP restored to full on transformation.
levels.4: Tectonic Authority — once per round, trigger a fissure (L×30 ft line, deal L² damage, apply L Crushed, terrain destroyed) as a 1 AP action.
levels.5: Primordial Eruption — once per session, cause a volcanic eruption in L×60 ft radius. All targets take L³ fire+earth damage, maximum Burned+Crushed stacks, terrain becomes a permanent lava field. Allies immune to fire damage for L days.

stormlord.name: Stormlord
stormlord.theme: The sky is your domain. The storm bows to you.

levels.1: Immune to lightning, wind, and air-based effects. Fly at your base movement speed.
levels.3: Storm Lord's Call — once per rest, summon a persistent thunderstorm over L×100 ft for L hours. Call lightning strikes (deal L² damage, apply L Stagger + L Burned) as a 1 AP action while it persists.
levels.4: Electromagnetic Mastery — disrupt all metal equipment within L×20 ft: metal weapons deal −L² damage, metal armor loses L Barrier stacks per round.
levels.5: Primordial Storm — once per session, unleash a full elemental hurricane in L×80 ft radius. All targets take L³ damage, maximum Stagger+Burned, hurled L×30 ft, cannot stand for L rounds. Allies gain maximum Haste stacks and +L² AP.

icelord.name: Icelord
icelord.theme: Winter has a name — and it is yours.

levels.1: Immune to cold and Slow effects. Sense temperature variations and ice formations within L×100 ft.
levels.3: Absolute Winter — once per rest, drop temperature in L×50 ft to absolute zero for L rounds. All targets become Frozen (Stunned + Restrained). Terrain becomes impassable ice. Allies unaffected.
levels.4: Ice Age — permanent cold zone (L×30 ft) centered on you. All targets in range: −L to all fire-based abilities. Ice effects in range deal +L² damage.
levels.5: Primordial Glacier — once per session, deep-freeze L×100 ft permanently. Everything inside encased in glacial ice (Frozen for L days). Requires L² force per 5 ft² to break. Allies move through freely.

dustlord.name: Dustlord
dustlord.theme: Everything returns to dust. You decide when.

levels.1: Immune to Blind, Crushed, and Stagger from physical matter. Know exact terrain configuration within L×100 ft.
levels.3: Erosion — once per rest, age and erode any non-living structure within L×30 ft. Stone becomes sand, wood becomes dust, metal loses L² Barrier stacks per round for L rounds.
levels.4: Matter Disintegration — once per round, reduce one solid object (up to L cubic ft) to inert dust as a 2 AP action.
levels.5: Primordial Dissolution — once per session, release disintegrating dust in L×60 ft radius. All solid non-living matter takes L³ damage (structural collapse). All targets take L² damage, receive maximum Crushed+Stagger, and lose all armor and shield effectiveness for L rounds.

bloodlord.name: Bloodlord
bloodlord.theme: Life flows through your hands. So does death.
limitations: No effect against constructs, undead, or machines — requires biological fluid to function.

levels.1: Sense the bloodflow and life force of every biological creature within L×60 ft. Know their exact HP, status conditions, and emotional state.
levels.3: Vital Command — once per rest, seize control of one biological target's circulatory system for L rounds. They act on your initiative and follow your commands.
levels.4: Blood Covenant — link two biological creatures (can include yourself). Damage is split evenly between them; healing is shared at half value. Lasts L hours.
levels.5: Primordial Life — once per session: restore a dead biological creature (died within L hours) to life with L² HP, OR drain one target instantly to 0 HP and distribute that HP among L willing allies within range. Constructs, undead, and machines are immune.

thermaflux_master.name: Thermaflux Master
thermaflux_master.theme: Temperature is a language, and you speak it without accent.

levels.1: Immune to all temperature-based damage and status effects. You exist in perfect thermal equilibrium.
levels.3: Continental Forge — once per rest, reshape L×200 ft of geological terrain over L hours. Create mountains, valleys, rivers, or lava fields. Effects are permanent.
levels.4: Thermal Authority — all Burned, Chilled, and Crushed stacks you apply are treated as L levels higher for resistance purposes and have +L to their maximum stack count.
levels.5: Primordial Thermodynamics — once per session, trigger absolute thermodynamic collapse in L×80 ft radius. Temperature drops to absolute zero then spikes to the heat of creation. All targets take L⁴ damage (split fire+cold), receive maximum of all thermal stacks. Allies are immune.

spiraflux_master.name: Spiraflux Master
spiraflux_master.theme: You are the eye of the storm. Everything else is weather.

levels.1: Immune to all weather effects, wind, rain, lightning, and cold. Fly at double base movement speed.
levels.3: Eye of the Storm — once per rest, conjure a permanent storm anchored to you (L×200 ft radius). The eye (L×20 ft around you) is perfectly calm. Outside: L² damage per round, maximum all atmospheric stacks.
levels.4: Atmospheric Dominion — once per round, change weather conditions anywhere within L×10 miles as a free action. Conditions stabilize over L rounds.
levels.5: Primordial Tempest — once per session, unleash a world-altering storm in L×500 ft radius. All targets take L⁴ atmospheric damage, maximum Stagger + Burned + Chilled. Storm persists L days unless dismissed. Allies pass through the eye freely.

ecoflux_master.name: Ecoflux Master
ecoflux_master.theme: The living world has always been listening. You are finally speaking.

levels.1: Commune with any living ecosystem — plants, animals, fungi, and microorganisms act as your senses and agents within L×500 ft.
levels.3: Lifeweave — once per rest, connect L creatures within L×100 ft. All damage taken by any connected creature is distributed equally among all. All healing is shared at half value. Duration: L hours.
levels.4: Ecological Mastery — accelerate or halt natural processes within L×100 ft as an action: age structures by centuries, grow forests instantly, or trigger and prevent natural disasters.
levels.5: Primordial Nature — once per session, awaken the will of the natural world in L×1 mile. Every plant, stone, and water body becomes an active participant in combat for L hours. Enemies in natural terrain take L² damage per round from the environment itself.

levels.1: Immune to explosive, fire, and earth damage. Active volcanic zones and standing lava restore L² HP per round.
levels.3: Mantle Tap — once per rest, access geothermal energy directly. For L rounds, all your abilities cost 0 MP. You emit a constant L² damage aura of superheated air and ash.
levels.4: Geological Event — once per rest, trigger a controlled eruption at any point within L×500 ft. Creates a new volcanic vent (manifests over L days) or collapses a structure with L² force damage instantly.
levels.5: Primordial Eruption — once per session, trigger a catastrophic geological event centered on yourself. L×200 ft radius. All structures collapse. All targets take L⁴ fire+earth+air damage, maximum Burned+Crushed+Stagger. Terrain permanently reshaped as you decree. Allies are protected inside a shell of solidified lava.

primallord.name: Primalist
primallord.theme: The four elements are not things you control — they are things you are. Fire, water, earth, and air move through you as a single continuous expression.

levels.1: All four elements respond to you without effort. Minor elemental effects — extinguishing flames, calming water, stilling wind, moving loose stone — require no action or resource cost.
levels.2: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. The MPR bonus from each T1 element you hold at Level 3+ stacks additively with yours.
levels.3: Elemental Confluence — 2 AP: enter complete elemental synchronization for L rounds. All attacks carry all four elemental damage types and apply L stacks each of Burned, Chilled, Crushed, and Stagger. You are immune to all elemental damage and status effects while active.
levels.4: Convergence Economy — any T2 or higher elemental ability costs 0 MP if you used at least one ability from each of its parent elements this encounter.
levels.5: Avatar State — once per session, become the living embodiment of all elements for L rounds. You are immune to all physical and elemental effects. Your presence applies maximum elemental stacks to all enemies within L×20 ft each round as a free action. You may reshape terrain within L×50 ft freely each round. Allies within range who hold any elemental affinity treat their elemental abilities as L levels higher.

fantasy.description: Schools of magical philosophy and technique. Shape spellcasting through disciplined study, experimentation, and ritual rather than primal or emotional resonance.
fantasy.unlock_rule: Each arcane affinity known counts toward the MND+SPT > Arcane Elemental total check for primal affinities.

levels.1: Astral Eye — 6 AP, 3L MP: Summon a floating sensor for L hours.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. +L to Detect, Insight, and Arcana checks.
levels.3: Eye gains the ability to relay emotional states or magical auras.
levels.4: Precognitive Insight: Reroll 1 failed roll per encounter.
levels.5: Maintain perfect awareness of all targets within line of sight.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.theme: The feminine principle of the universe. Nuance, individuality, and the emergence of the Many from the One. Shadow draws inward where Light projects outward.

1.effect: Shadow Drain — 2 AP, L MP: deal L shadow damage to a target. Heal self for half. Apply L stacks of Obscured (target loses visual clarity, -L to their rolls).

2.effect: Max MP +L²; MPR +L. +L to stealth and perception checks in darkness.

3.effect: Fracture: create L zones of magical darkness (15 ft radius each) — non-Shadow users cannot perceive within. Shadow damage heals +L.

4.effect: Shade Echo: your shadow acts independently for L rounds — cannot deal damage but can interact with objects, flank, or distract as a free action. +L to attacks vs Obscured targets.

5.effect: Shadow Step: enter or exit any shadow within L×10 ft as a free action once per turn. Shadow healing ignores shields and barriers.

light.name: Light
light.theme: The masculine principle of the universe. Direct creation, singular clarity, the One from which all individuation flows.

1.effect: Radiant Emission — 2 AP, L MP: deal L radiant damage to one target OR restore L HP to one ally. Target is Illuminated for L rounds (cannot benefit from stealth or concealment).

3.effect: Overhealing converts excess HP to a temporary shield equal to the overflow. Shielded targets gain +L to Defense rolls.

4.effect: Illuminated targets suffer -L to all rolls. Allies attacking Illuminated targets gain +L to attack rolls.

5.effect: When radiant healing exceeds the target's maximum HP, each overflow point generates 1 AP (not lost at end of round). Once per round.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.theme: Manipulation of gravitational force. The pull that gives mass meaning and makes motion consequential.

1.effect: Gravitational Pull — 2 AP, L MP: pull one target up to L×5 ft toward you. Apply Weighted for L rounds (movement reduced by L spaces per turn).

3.effect: Gravity Field — L×5 ft radius for L rounds: all targets gain Weighted and cannot jump or fly. Weighted targets take +L falling damage.

4.effect: Gravity Crush — 2 AP, 2L MP: deal L² bludgeoning damage to one target. Each Weighted stack on the target adds +L damage.

5.effect: Gravity Reversal — 3 AP, 3L MP: reverse gravity in L×10 ft zone for L rounds. Targets are flung upward and take L² falling damage on return. Once per rest.

vibration.name: Vibration
vibration.theme: Manipulation of wave propagation and resonant frequency. Everything that exists vibrates — mastery is knowing which frequency breaks what.

1.effect: Resonant Strike — 2 AP, L MP: deal L sonic damage. Apply L stacks of Resonance (each stack causes the target to take +L bonus damage on the next hit they receive).

3.effect: Shatter: targets with L+ Resonance stacks take double damage from the next physical hit. Against structures or objects, deal ×L damage instead.

4.effect: Frequency Lock — 2 AP, 2L MP: Stagger target and prevent verbal spell components for L rounds.

5.effect: Shockwave — 3 AP, 3L MP: L×10 ft cone of pure vibration. All targets take L² sonic damage, are knocked back L×5 ft, and gain L Resonance stacks.

levels.1: Animate Corpse — 6 AP, 3L MP: Animate a medium or two small corpses for 3L turns. Max 3 medium or 6 small active.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. Double summoned corpse duration.
levels.3: Animate Corpse AP cost -3.
levels.4: Increase limits to 1 Large, 2 Medium, or 4 Small per summon.
levels.5: Raise limit to 3 Large, 6 Medium, or 12 Small active at once.

levels.1: Transmute Matter — 6 AP, 3L MP: Transform an object into another of similar mass or size.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. +L to skill checks for altering properties (weight, density, form).
levels.3: May animate objects to perform simple tasks (1 AP actions).
levels.4: Transmuted objects persist 2× as long and resist dispelling.
levels.5: Transmute living matter (plants, non-sapient creatures) with extended rituals.

levels.1: On Elemental Affinity Hit: Restore L MP.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. All Affinity spell ranges increase by 10×L ft.
levels.3: Gain +L to Affinity AoE sizes or cone lengths.
levels.4: Empowered Cast: once per turn, double affinity damage dice.
levels.5: All elemental spells ignore 1 point of Resistance per level in this skill.

levels.1: Energy Shields gain +L Damage Resistance.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. Gain resistance to dispel or counterspells.
levels.3: Warded Stance: passive shield resists elemental splash effects.
levels.4: Reflexive Ward: once per round, reduce incoming spell damage by L×2.
levels.5: Maintain passive barrier even while unconscious.

levels.1: 1 AP, 2L MP: Weapon gains one Affinity for 2L turns, applying On Hit triggers.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. May apply L Augments simultaneously.
levels.3: On Hit triggers apply stacks equal to Affinity skill level.
levels.4: Augments last indefinitely but count against enchantment limit.
levels.5: Augmented weapons apply +L to Affinity skill checks.

levels.1: +L MPR. Substitute SPT for MND on any magic attack rolls or checks.
levels.2: +L to resist Charm, Fear, and Illusion effects.
levels.3: Communicate telepathically with one creature within 10×L ft.
levels.4: Control the emotions of a target for L rounds with a successful opposed roll.
levels.5: Dominate a target (charm + command effect) for 1 round once per rest.

entropy.name: Entropy

prerequisite.description: Requires mastery of 5 different Arcane affinities.

levels.1: On hit with Affinity abilities, apply +L Null (prevents regeneration for 1 round).
levels.2: +L MPR. Regain L MP when a status effect ends.
levels.3: Stacking effects you apply do not decay naturally.
levels.4: Ignore line of sight and cover for Affinity effects.
levels.5: Targets killed while a stacking effect is active cannot be resurrected for L rounds.

entropy.theme: The natural movement of matter toward dispersion. Not destruction — dissolution. The universe trending toward chaos from within.

balance.name: Balance
balance.theme: The harmony of Light and Shadow. Direct action informed by nuanced thought. The masculine and feminine principles in conscious accord.

1.effect: Balanced Emission — 2 AP, L MP: deal L radiant and L shadow damage simultaneously. Ignores resistance to either type individually.

3.effect: Adaptive Approach: once per round as a free action, shift between Light mode (+L direct damage) and Shadow mode (+L Obscured stacks on hit, drain L HP).

4.effect: Dual Presence: you register simultaneously as illuminated and shadowed — enemies have -L to determine your exact position or target you specifically.

5.effect: Transcendent Balance: Light and Shadow effects you apply deal +L damage and grant +L stacks. Cannot be countered by effects targeting only one domain.

levels.1: Create sensory phantasms for up to L×10 minutes (sight, sound, smell).
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. Illusions may mimic physical presence but deal no damage.
levels.3: Illusory Assault: target rolls defense vs false damage or suffers penalty.
levels.4: Create illusions that persist while unattended or across areas.
levels.5: Illusions are semi-autonomous and may mimic up to L commands.

levels.1: Summon Object — 6 AP, 3L MP: Conjure a Medium or smaller item for L hours.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. Conjured items may include minor enchantments.
levels.3: Reduce AP cost by -2. Duration doubled.
levels.4: Create large or complex objects (tents, carts, siege tools).
levels.5: Conjured objects function as real and persist up to L days.

levels.1: 3 AP, 3L MP: Apply L² Haste stacks in 15×L ft radius.
levels.2: 2 AP, 3L MP: Apply L² Slow stacks to a single target.
levels.3: +L Max MP and MPR. Dodge no longer causes double damage on failure.
levels.4: Echo Step: once per round, repeat one movement-based action.
levels.5: May act during another character's turn once per round at -1 AP cost.

levels.1: +L MPR. When you sleep, gain visions that may reveal hidden truths. +L to resist Illusion and Fear effects.
levels.2: Cast minor illusionary effects during rest or meditation. Regain L MP if unbothered during full rest.
levels.3: +L to resist sleep and unconscious states. Dreams you shape may interact with other dreamers.
levels.4: While unconscious or meditating, send a short telepathic message to a known target. +L to control shared dreamscapes.
levels.5: Project yourself into the Dreamscape once per long rest for L minutes. Actions can influence waking world NPCs (GM discretion).

levels.1: +L MPR. Carve magical sigils that hold 1 spell for delayed activation.
levels.2: Sigils may affect up to L targets. Triggering range increased to 10×L ft.
levels.3: Embed L sigils into weapons, armor, or surfaces for persistent field effects.
levels.4: Sigils can be triggered remotely or set to automatic conditional logic.
levels.5: Combine two different spells into one sigil, activating simultaneously.

order.name: Order
order.theme: The organizing principle of the universe. Structure, pattern, and the imposition of law on chaos.

requirements.description: Two T1 Arcane affinities at Level 2+

1.effect: Impose Order — 2 AP, L MP: remove L stacks of any chaotic or destabilizing effect from an ally, or suppress a target's next random effect entirely.

3.effect: Structured Field — L×10 ft zone for L rounds: chaos-based and random effects cannot trigger within. Allies gain +L to all rolls from clarity of mind.

4.effect: Binding Law — 2 AP, 2L MP: impose one behavioral constraint on a target for L rounds (resisted by MND). Examples: cannot attack first, cannot move more than 5 ft, cannot use abilities.

5.effect: Perfect Structure: once per rest — all allies in L×15 ft treat their next roll as the maximum possible result. Chaos and entropy effects are fully suppressed in the zone for L rounds.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.theme: The disordering principle within the universe. Unpredictability, the unraveling of pattern, generative destabilization. Distinct from the cosmic Void — this is disorder within creation, not outside it.

requirements.description: Two T1 Arcane affinities at Level 2+

1.effect: Unravel — 2 AP, L MP: strip L stacks of any structured buff or enchantment from a target. Organized effects on the target are suppressed for 1 round.

3.effect: Chaos Field — L×10 ft zone for L rounds: all rolls within gain a secret ±L modifier determined by the GM. Structured effects have a L-in-10 chance of misfiring each round.

4.effect: Cascade Failure: when any structured effect (barrier, enchantment, binding) ends within L×15 ft, it deals L damage to whoever created or maintained it.

5.effect: Unmaking — 3 AP, 3L MP: collapse one organized system (formation, enchantment, ritual, constructed terrain) instantly. Deals L² damage distributed among all who depended on it. Once per rest.

probability.name: Probability
probability.theme: Manipulation of chance and causality. Bending the likelihood of outcomes without directly forcing them — the universe nudged rather than broken.

requirements.description: Two T1 Arcane affinities at Level 2+

1.effect: Luck Shift — 1 AP, L MP: force one target to reroll their next attack or defense roll and take the worse result.

3.effect: Probability Field — L×10 ft aura for L rounds: allies reroll once per round and take the better result. Enemies reroll and take the worse.

4.effect: Cascade: when an enemy misses within the field, trigger one free attack against them from an ally of your choice.

5.effect: Determinism: once per rest, declare one upcoming roll must succeed or fail — the next qualifying roll automatically hits or misses. GM defines maximum scope.

levels.1: +L MPR. Once per day, teleport self and carried items up to 10×L ft in line of sight.
levels.2: +L to Initiative and Reflex. Teleport a willing ally within 5×L ft to nearby safe square as a reaction.
levels.3: Once per combat, delay a teleport up to L turns, activating as free action later.
levels.4: Teleport no longer triggers opportunity attacks. Regain L MP when teleporting into danger.
levels.5: Once per rest, Mass Teleport up to L allies (100×L ft range). Arrival must be known or visible location.

levels.1: +L MPR. Your spells may be delayed by 1 round without losing effectiveness.
levels.2: +L to Initiative and Temporal magic rolls. Spells may be queued and auto-triggered under set conditions.
levels.3: Delay an enemy's action by L ticks with a successful opposed MND check.
levels.4: Take 1 additional reaction per round, usable only for time-based effects or parries.
levels.5: Once per rest, rewind your own position to L ticks ago (position, HP, and active conditions only).

levels.1: +L MPR. Craft temporary runes granting +L to spell rolls or damage of chosen element.
levels.2: Runes grant Resistance L to a chosen energy type while active.
levels.3: Up to L runes active at once. Apply runes as bonus action.
levels.4: Create semi-permanent runic glyphs empowering areas (shrines, battlegrounds, fortifications).
levels.5: Once per rest, inscribe a Master Rune granting +L to all allies' MP regen and damage resistances in 20 ft radius.

requirements.description: Access to at least 3 different magical traditions

levels.1: +L MPR. Substitute one component of a spell (verbal, somatic, material) with another.
levels.2: Choose 1 spell from another Arcane Domain and treat it as from your primary Domain.
levels.3: +L to cast hybrid spells using elements from two different Domains.
levels.4: Spend L MP to convert any affinity ability into an Arcane Domain spell temporarily.
levels.5: Once per day, replicate any spell cast within 100 ft in the last L rounds.

creation.name: Creation
creation.theme: The product of Order and Chaos held in tension. Bringing new things into existence through the interplay of structure and boundless possibility.

1.effect: Manifest — 3 AP, 3L MP: bring a simple object or bounded effect into existence from pure intent. Scale limited to L size categories. Duration: L hours.

3.effect: Created objects and effects have L DR and persist L days without concentration.

4.effect: Created constructs follow simple commands and take 1 AP actions per round of their own accord.

5.effect: True Creation — ritual, 1 hour, L×10 MP: bring into permanent existence something that did not previously exist. Scope defined collaboratively with GM. Once per long rest.

time.name: Time
time.theme: Mastery of temporal flow. Time and Space are separate but connected — deep enough understanding of one will surface anomalies of the other. Requires broad investment across Arcane rather than a single chain.

prerequisite.description: Five or more Arcane Affinities at Level 3+, including Chronomancy at Level 4.

1.effect: Perceive time non-linearly within L rounds — know the exact action order for the next L initiative ticks before they occur.

3.effect: Time Dilation: L×10 ft zone for L rounds — all targets within (including allies) act at half initiative speed or double, your choice each round.

4.effect: Temporal Echo: when you would take damage that would reduce you to 0 HP, rewind yourself L rounds (position, HP, and active conditions only). Once per rest.

5.effect: Time Lock: once per rest, freeze one target completely for L rounds — they cannot act, be harmed, or be affected by anything. When released, they resume exactly as left. Spatial anomalies occasionally manifest at GM discretion.

space.name: Space
space.theme: Mastery of spatial structure. Space and Time are separate but connected — deep enough understanding of one will surface anomalies of the other. Requires broad investment across Arcane rather than a single chain.

prerequisite.description: Five or more Arcane Affinities at Level 3+, including Teleportation at Level 4.

1.effect: Perceive spatial relationships perfectly within L×100 ft — no cover, no concealment, exact positions always known.

3.effect: Fold Space: teleport yourself and up to L willing targets to any location you have personally visited, regardless of distance. Once per rest.

4.effect: Spatial Anchor: designate a L×20 ft zone. Nothing enters or exits without your permission — teleportation, movement, and projectiles are all blocked.

5.effect: Dimensional Rift: once per rest, tear open a temporary portal between two known locations. The rift lasts L rounds and any number of creatures can pass through. Temporal anomalies occasionally manifest at GM discretion.
